Public Sector Partnerships Lead - France

About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

We are seeking an experienced and dynamic leader to build ElevenLabs' public sector business across France. The Public Sector Partnerships Lead will identify and build relationships with government institutions across France, bridging the gap between government and our GTM team to drive adoption of ElevenLabs' products and grow government into a strong, durable revenue stream for the company. The role also involves building strategic partnerships with policymakers, industry associations, and coalitions, as well as monitoring regulatory developments and supporting policy campaigns and impact initiatives.

In this role, you will:

Drive government adoption and revenue (primary)

  • Identify government partnership opportunities across France — from healthcare and education to transport, public banks, and other state-owned enterprises — and bridge the gap between government institutions and the GTM team to drive adoption and deployment of ElevenLabs' products.

  • Build and maintain a wide network of relationships across French government institutions — spanning ministries, agencies, établissements publics, and SOEs — not limited to regulatory or policy counterparts.

  • Promote government adoption of ElevenLabs products and services in partnership with the GTM team.

Build strategic partnerships (secondary)

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with policymakers, regulators, industry associations, and civil society groups.

  • Represent ElevenLabs at conferences and industry events, advancing the company's public policy goals.

Monitor and advise on policy (tertiary)

  • Lead ElevenLabs engagement with government bodies and officials across France, with a focus on AI governance, safety, copyright, privacy, transparency, data protection, competition, and/or digital rights.

  • Monitor, analyze, and advise on emerging regulations impacting the company — including EU-level developments given France's influence in shaping EU AI policy.

  • Support the development of internal policies by our Legal, Safety, Security, and other teams.

  • Provide strategic counsel to company leadership on regional policy trends and their business implications.

  • Define and implement policy campaigns and impact initiatives that advance company objectives.

Who you are:

  • You're genuinely interested in the future of AI and emerging technologies, bringing curiosity and enthusiasm to your role.

  • You stay up-to-date on AI regulation and industry trends, and are eager to apply this expertise to cutting-edge products.

  • You thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic startup environment, working cross-functionally with teams across the organization to support and scale a growing business.

  • You're comfortable working independently and handling ambiguity, excelling in situations where you must make informed decisions quickly.

  • You bring a proactive, solution-oriented approach to each project, focused on moving the business forward.

What you bring:

Primary requirements

  • 10+ years' experience in public and private sector (in-house, firm) roles, with a track record of building relationships with government that led to commercial or technology-adoption outcomes — not solely policy or regulatory roles.

  • A wide, current network of contacts across French government institutions — spanning ministries, agencies, établissements publics, and SOEs, including in healthcare, education, and transport. Prior government or grands corps experience is a plus but not required if network breadth is strong.

  • Experience identifying and opening doors for technology partnerships with government institutions is strongly preferred.

  • Contacts or experience navigating EU institutions or other major European markets is a plus.

Also required

  • Strong knowledge of the French and EU AI policy landscape, including general AI governance, safety, copyright, privacy, transparency, data protection, competition, and digital rights.

  • Demonstrated success in designing, advocating for, and influencing policy outcomes, as well as coalition building.

  • Public policy experience across France.

  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, including when briefing government officials and other policymakers.

  • Fluency in English and French.

Location

This role is located in France.

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

jobs.title: System Architect
jobs.description:
System Architect

Hyperscale Power is building the power backbone for the AI data center era: a complete power conversion chain from 13.8kV–35kV medium-voltage AC down to 800V DC, combining ultra-compact SiC-based power blocks. Our Solid-State Transformers (SSTs) are the core of this revolution, providing unprecedented control, efficiency, and compactness.

As a System Architect, you will be responsible for our solid-state transformer as a complete system. You will connect the work of our power electronics, magnetics, and mechanical and thermal engineering teams into one coherent system, and ensure it meets the requirements of hyperscale data center customers.

Instead of specializing in a single subsystem, your mission is to keep the whole system in view: balancing efficiency, size, cost, reliability and manufacturability, guiding the key technical trade-offs, and taking our SST from prototype to a product ready for certification and series production.

This role is for you if…
you’ve owned a complex high-power system rather than one part of it. You enjoy keeping the whole picture in view, making the call on trade-offs between expert teams, and bringing just enough structure to a fast-moving team without slowing it down.

This role isn’t for you if…
you’ve spent your career going deep on a single component or subsystem, or you manage projects without making the technical decisions yourself. It’s also not a fit if you need a fixed specification and established processes before you can start.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own the system architecture of the SST and its key performance metrics, including efficiency, power density, cost, thermal performance, reliability, manufacturability and control performance.

  • Coordinate the subsystems of the SST (AC/DC, DC/DC, magnetics, mechanical and thermal) and their interfaces, ensuring the work of each team is compatible and consistent with the system design.

  • Lead system-level trade-off decisions and set technical priorities across teams.

  • Define and maintain system requirements, interface specifications and change management, ensuring design changes are assessed for their impact across the system.

  • Translate the requirements of data center operators and hyperscalers into system specifications, and track how they evolve.

  • Explore and compare different system architectures and their integration in the datacenter power supply chain

  • Drive standardization and design for manufacturing across subsystems in preparation for series production.

  • Work with the compliance and certification team to define a feasible certification path for the system.

  • Identify technical risks at system level early and propose mitigations.

Qualifications

  • MSc or a higher degree in Electrical Engineering or a related discipline.

  • 8+ years of industry experience in developing complex power electronic systems.

  • Proven responsibility at system or platform level, e.g. as system engineer, system architect, technical lead or team lead.

  • Track record of taking power electronic systems from development to series product.

  • Experience with high-power systems such as EV charging, electric drivetrains, rail traction, industrial drives, renewable energy converters or robotics.

  • Broad understanding of the electrical, magnetic, thermal, mechanical and control aspects of power electronic systems, and how they interact.

  • Working knowledge of cooling concepts and the mechanical integration of high-power electronics.

  • Experience with standards, norms and certification processes for power electronic products.

  • Strong communication and decision-making skills; able to align experts across disciplines and drive decisions.

  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced startup environment with evolving requirements.

The job will be located at our HQ in Egg b. Zürich, Switzerland.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with medium-voltage converter systems or solid-state transformers.

  • Knowledge of data center power architectures.

  • Experience in design for manufacturing and cost engineering.

  • Experience establishing systems engineering processes in a growing organization.

Benefits

  • Equity + competitive salary.

  • Unique technology and market opportunity – shape the architecture of a new product category for the energy transition.

  • Hybrid work with flexible working times.

Daarnaast zijn wij bij uitstek een organisatie waar je vrijheid krijgt, waar ondernemerschap wordt beloond en waarin je de ruimte krijgt om je ideeën tot uitvoering te brengen. We bieden je een dynamische omgeving met de ruimte om snel stappen te maken, door te groeien en verantwoordelijkheid te nemen. Je bent onderdeel van een wereldwijd bedrijf waar de nuchtere Twentse cultuur bewaard is gebleven.

 

Bij ons krijg je uitdagend werk, veel vertrouwen en ruimte om jezelf te blijven ontwikkelen. Je werkt met nuchtere collega’s in een informele cultuur, met goede voorwaarden om duurzaam te presteren.

 

Daarnaast bieden wij:

  • Een aantrekkelijk salaris passend bij de verantwoordelijkheden en het potentieel binnen de rol.

  • Een managementcontract met veel ruimte voor ondernemerschap, eigen verantwoordelijkheid en impact op de verdere ontwikkeling van de organisatie.

Wie ben jij?

Of je nu een ervaren engineering manager bent of toe bent aan je eerste grotere leiderschapsrol, jij krijgt energie van technologie én het ontwikkelen van mensen. Je weet professionals te verbinden, richting te geven en samen resultaten te behalen in een complexe high-tech omgeving. Met jouw technische achtergrond, nieuwsgierigheid en leiderschapspotentieel bouw je mee aan de volgende generatie engineers én innovaties. Je combineert flexibiliteit met een sterke interesse in technologie, bent van nature nieuwsgierig en floreert in een agile omgeving. Herken jij jezelf hierin? Dan maken we graag kennis met je.

 

Daarnaast zien wij graag:

  • Een afgeronde hbo- of wo-opleiding in embedded software, elektrotechniek, natuurkunde  of een vergelijkbare technische richting.

  • Je hebt een stevige achtergrond in electrical engineering en voldoende technische diepgang om met engineers en architecten te sparren over technische keuzes en ontwikkelrichtingen.

  • Minimaal zeven jaar ervaring binnen een hightech-ontwikkelomgeving, inclusief enkele jaren in een leidinggevende rol of een technische leiderschapsrol.

  • Uitstekende communicatieve vaardigheden en een goede beheersing van zowel de Nederlandse als Engelse taal.

 

Serious Tech
Bij Benchmark werk je voor bedrijven die impact maken met hun innovaties. Zo ontwikkelen we nieuwe producten die de veiligheid of gezondheid verbeteren of juist het gemak vergroten. Deze producten worden geleverd vanaf het productontwerp tot en met volumeproductie en soms ook rechtstreeks aan de eindgebruiker. Technisch ligt de lat hoog, maar de cultuur blijft nuchter en dichtbij. Je werkt met mensen die verantwoordelijkheid nemen, elkaar helpen en samen willen blijven verbeteren.

 

Seriously you?

jobs.title: Senior Account Executive - Benelux
jobs.description:
Senior Account Executive - Benelux

Help fix customer-centricity at scale


Every company wants to become more customer-centric. At TheyDo, we make that ambition real. Our AI-powered journey management platform helps the world’s largest enterprises align around what matters most: their customers. By bringing scattered data and teams together, we empower smarter decisions and better experiences. Since 2019, global leaders across industries — including Ford, Cisco, Johnson & Johnson, Siemens, Home Depot, and Lufthansa — have trusted us to scale journey management and deliver measurable impact.

Backed by $50M from top-tier investors, including Blossom and 20VC, we are building a category-defining company. Our fully remote team of 100+ TheyDoers represents 30+ nationalities across 27 countries, united by a customer-led, people-first culture.

Our mission is clear: Make journey management the most powerful business tool in the world.

If you’re looking for a place where your work shapes the future of how companies operate, join us. Let’s build it together.

The role

Journey management is becoming a must-have for the world's biggest companies, and TheyDo is the platform leading the category. Enterprises like Ford, Cisco, Vodafone and Pfizer already use TheyDo to understand their customers end to end and decide where to act.

Now we're going after the rest of Europes biggest brands, and we want you leading the charge. As a Senior Account Executive, you'll take a greenfield territory of enterprise accounts, open the doors, and land the new logos that define TheyDo's next chapter.

You'll be based in the Benelux, working remotely and reporting to Stephan. You'll join a team of 6 EU AEs, backed by SDR, Enablement and Customer Success colleagues across North America and Europe.

Why this role, now

The timing couldn't be better. Customer experience has moved into the boardroom, and enterprises want a way to turn it into decisions. TheyDo gives them that, and our customers are proving it.

Europe is wide open. Your target list is full of companies that look just like the ones already buying from us, and most of them have never had a TheyDo conversation. We know what wins. Now we need someone to scale it and put their name on the logos that come next.

This is the moment to join: early enough to shape how we win, with the proof that we do.

What you'll do

This is a role built around creating revenue that didn't exist before, not managing revenue that already does.

Build your own pipeline. You'll start from a target list, not a book.

  • Own a named list of Benelux enterprise accounts and decide where to focus, based on signal rather than hope

  • Source most of your pipeline yourself through outbound, account-based plays with BDR and Marketing, events and executive networking

  • Break into accounts with no existing relationship and find the senior person who owns the customer experience problem


Win the first deal. You'll take a cold account all the way to signature.

  • Run complex, multi-stakeholder cycles from first conversation through discovery, business case, procurement and close

  • Sell on value to C-level and VP buyers across CX, Product and Digital: a business case a CFO will sign, not a feature tour

  • Land mid-to-high six-figure first deals, structured to expand, and hand them to Customer Success with the context to grow them

Shape how we win. You'll help write the European playbook.

  • Refine our ICP, messaging and sales motion based on what you see in the field

  • Share buyer insight with Product so they can act on it

  • Forecast accurately and keep the team informed through clear async updates

What this role isn't

We'd rather be clear now than have the wrong person find out six months in.

  • It isn't account management. You won't inherit renewals or an installed base to upsell. If most of your number has come from growing existing customers, this probably isn't your role.

  • It isn't inbound-led. Marketing and SDR will support you, but you'll be expected to create most of your own pipeline.

  • It isn't a finished machine. If you need fully built enablement, years of territory data and a playbook that tells you what to do next, you'll find this frustrating. If you want to help build those things, you'll find it energizing.

What we're looking for

  • 4+ years closing B2B SaaS deals, with most of that in enterprise new-business roles selling into enterprise organizations.

  • A track record of exceeding annual quotas, where the majority of your closed revenue came from net-new logos you sourced yourself. Be ready to walk us through the numbers.

  • Proven ability to land mid-to-high six-figure first deals with enterprises that weren't customers before.

  • Experience selling a platform or new-category product, where you had to create the need rather than respond to an RFP.

  • A value-selling methodology (MEDDPICC, Command of the Message or similar) you actually use, not just know.

  • Confidence engaging C-level buyers, building consensus across stakeholders and navigating enterprise procurement, security and legal

  • You'd rather start with a blank target list than a handed-over book, and you're energized by a scale-up where the product and playbook move fast

Bonus points if you have experience selling to CX, Product, Digital or Design leaders

What we offer our permanent employees:

💰 Competitive compensation and pre-IPO equity - we like to give our team members ownership with our stock package. When TheyDo succeeds, we all succeed!

🌍 Fully remote working with flexible hours - we're staunch advocates for autonomy and flexibility.

🩺 Health Insurance benefit - at TheyDo our team’s health and wellbeing are a priority. We include tailored support for every employee, regardless of location.

🌴 Flexible holiday days – We love what we do and equally love taking a break. You'll have a minimum of 25 days of paid holiday per year (pro rata), in addition to public holidays and an extra three days during our annual company-wide winter shutdown in December.

🧠 Learning and Development budget we encourage everyone to take ownership and invest in their growth and development, providing financial support to benefit you in your role and career.

🧘‍♂️Wellbeing budget - nurture your mind and body. We’ll support you in looking after you, whether it's meditation, mindfulness, or a yoga/gym membership.

👪 Paid parental leave - we'll ensure financial support and time off for you to bond with the newest little members of your family (6 months for the primary carer, and 6 weeks for the secondary carer - fully paid). We provide paid childcare leave when you need to take time out to help your little one recover.

👨‍💻Home office or co-working support - choose your ideal workspace with our home office or co-working budget. Whether you prefer the comfort of your home office or the collaborative atmosphere of a co-working space, we've got you covered.

🗺️ Company events - we regularly connect in-person to strategise, reflect or simply have fun. Our most recent company retreats were held in Spain, Portugal and France.

⚒️ Latest tech & tools - MacBook Air or Pro, we want you to have the equipment that you’re most comfortable with. We use tools such as Gather, Slack, Notion, Loom, G:Suite and naturally TheyDo to work collaboratively and asynchronously.

🚀 Continuous growth of our benefits package as we continue to grow in size

To any recruitment agencies, we appreciate you would like to support us but we do not accept any unsolicited CVs or introductions.

About TheyDo

Our core values are the driving force behind every decision we make.

We ‘Journey together’ along a path of collaboration and synchronization. In everything we do, we ‘Own it’, never shying away from taking action or making decisions. Our ‘Cloaks off’ mentality ensures that transparency and integrity reign supreme. We ‘Simply to accelerate', cutting through complexity to focus on what truly matters and moving forward with clarity and speed Moreover, ‘Customer Fueled’ innovation is at the heart of our work, as we know that the success of our product is directly linked to how we involve our customers in the process.

TheyDo is an equal opportunities employer. Our customers are diverse, and we believe our organisation should be, too. We nurture an inclusive culture where everyone feels equally important, no matter their background or status. We will never discriminate on the grounds of gender, civil status, family status, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, education, or race.

Our commitment to building a diverse and inclusive TheyDo includes making reasonable adjustments to the interview process. If you need any adjustments, please reach out to your Talent Partner.

If you are a woman or part of an underrepresented group, we encourage you to apply. Even if you don’t check every box — your skills and perspective could be just what we need to succeed. We value diversity and know you bring something unique to the table!

AI Engineer

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an AI Engineer based in Netherlands.

We are looking for an experienced AI Engineer to build and deploy production-grade AI systems that address complex challenges across heavy industries, including utilities, manufacturing, logistics, and energy. You will play a key role in developing a next-generation industrial operating system, taking innovative products from concept to production. The role combines agentic AI, multimodal machine learning, industrial data integration, and full-stack engineering. You will work with real-world data from sensors, machines, and operational systems to deliver intelligent solutions that improve efficiency, reliability, and decision-making. This is a high-ownership opportunity in a fast-moving, zero-to-one product environment. You will help establish the foundations of an ambitious platform designed to transform industrial operations.


Accountabilities

You will design, build, and ship the core AI capabilities of an industrial intelligence platform, connecting advanced models with operational data, enterprise systems, and practical decision-making tools.

  • Develop and deploy agentic AI systems, including orchestration, tool use, state management, and human-in-the-loop workflows.

  • Build agent runtimes and orchestration frameworks supporting specialized agents for vision quality, predictive maintenance, and operations planning.

  • Design context assembly systems using industrial ontologies and memory, including tool dispatch, approval gates, tracing, and cost controls.

  • Develop multimodal data pipelines combining video processing, computer vision, and structured operational data.

  • Implement computer vision capabilities such as object detection, segmentation, and action recognition, using technologies such as YOLO and OpenCV.

  • Process industrial sensor data, including RTSP video, time-series telemetry, vibration, thermal data, and PLC/OPC-UA streams.

  • Build signal-processing and sensor-correlation workflows, including FFT feature extraction and cross-sensor analysis.

  • Design and contribute to industrial ontologies and knowledge graphs representing plants, assets, sensors, work orders, materials, and maintenance histories.

  • Develop memory systems for trace storage, playbooks, asset templates, and reusable failure-pattern libraries.

  • Build operational interfaces such as dashboards, evidence-based alerting workflows, replanning tools, and audit trails.

  • Develop integration connectors for ERP, CMMS, WMS, industrial historians, and PLC systems, ensuring data normalization and consistent schema mapping.

  • Deliver end-to-end solutions spanning data ingestion, model serving, backend services, and frontend interfaces.

  • Ensure production systems meet demanding requirements for reliability, latency, scalability, cost efficiency, and operational usability.

    • Requirements

    The ideal candidate is an autonomous, hands-on AI engineer with experience taking complex systems from initial development to production, particularly in environments involving physical-world data and industrial operations.

    • At least 3 years of experience building and shipping production AI systems; 5+ years preferred.

    • Proven experience developing agentic AI products and production systems, including orchestration, tool integration, state management, and human oversight.

    • Experience as an early-stage engineer at a venture-backed startup, contributing to products and systems from zero to one.

    • Experience working with large-scale industrial data, such as video streams, IoT devices, sensor telemetry, vibration, thermal data, or PLC/OPC-UA systems.

    • Hands-on experience building multimodal AI pipelines that combine computer vision with structured operational data.

    • Understanding of data ingestion, normalization, temporal alignment, data quality, and ground-truth challenges in real-world environments.

    • Experience with industrial ontologies, knowledge graphs, or structured context systems based on asset hierarchies and operational processes.

    • Experience integrating AI systems with enterprise and industrial platforms such as ERP, CMMS, WMS, historians, or PLC systems.

    • Strong software engineering skills across backend and frontend development, including Python and TypeScript.

    • Experience with production-oriented technologies such as FastAPI, PostgreSQL, React Native, and OpenCV.

    • A practical understanding of system reliability, failure modes, latency, cost management, and human interaction.

    • Ability to work autonomously, take ownership, and deliver in a fast-paced, high-intensity environment.

    • Strong motivation to solve complex industrial challenges through hands-on engineering and applied AI.

      • Benefits

      • Opportunity to help build a category-defining industrial operating system with the potential to shape manufacturing plants and industrial facilities over the next 10–20 years.

      • Exceptional employee equity package, with an equity pool described as twice the industry standard and an estimated value of more than $200,000 from day one.

      • Opportunity to work alongside an experienced team with backgrounds in enterprise technology, industrial robotics, autonomous driving, and academic research.

      • Exposure to complex, real-world industrial challenges and large volumes of underutilized sensor data.

      • Direct impact on operational efficiency, predictive maintenance, industrial reliability, and decision-making across major industries.

      • Opportunity to contribute to a zero-to-one product in an ambitious, innovation-driven environment.

About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

Together, we can change the paradigm of how the world connects

About our technology

The semiconductor industry’s growing demand for more powerful chips with higher bandwidth and lower power finds its solution in our technology. We connect chips to high-throughput, low-delay computing networks. The key lies in harnessing the physical properties of graphene to combine electronic computing with photonic communication, allowing countless chips to interact almost as if they were one. Our graphene photonic innovation increases computing power and efficiency to a new order of magnitude

In short, we connect chips to create powerful and energy-efficient networks, overcoming connectivity limitations in the semiconductor industry. We deliver the graphene solution

 

The Role

We are looking for a Graphene Device Physics Modeling Expert, to develop and refine physics based models for graphene photonic devices. Working at the intersection of research and software development you will translate state-of-the-art research into reliable simulation capabilities that support device design and development.

To join our team, you should be excited to:

  • Research the literature on state-of-the-art approaches to graphene device modeling and simulation

  • Work with commercial TCAD and multiphysics simulation tools

  • Translate physical models from scientific literature into robust, maintainable Python code

  • Develop and extend models for graphene-based photonic devices, incorporating new physical effects and functionalities

  • Calibrate, validate, and refine models using experimental characterization data

  • Collaborate closely with various teams, prioritizing modeling activities in line with team and company goals

  • Document your work clearly and contribute to shared software-development practices

Your Qualifications

  • PhD in Physics, Materials Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field

  • Strong foundation in solid-state physics, semiconductor physics, and mathematics

  • Proficient in modeling techniques and methodologies for semiconductor physics

  • Proven ability to translate scientific literature and mathematical models into simulation code

  • Experience with TCAD development

  • Proficiency in Python and Git

  • Experience solving partial differential equations, particularly for charge and heat transport

  • Experience with graphene and photonics

  • Experience with commercial simulation tools such as COMSOL Multiphysics or Ansys Lumerical is a plus

Our work culture

People Over Processes. At Black Semiconductor, flexibility is key—we ensure work adapts to life, not the other way around. We champion work-life harmony, where careers are meaningful and enriching. Our processes are human-centric, allowing you to focus on what matters

We Live Openness. Collaboration and inclusivity are the cornerstones of our culture. We practice openness, fostering trust and respect. Individuality is our collective strength, fueling innovation and driving us forward

We connect chips – and people. We encourage qualified individuals from any background to apply. We foster an inclusive and supportive work environment that values collaboration, innovation, and growth. Join our team and be part of an organization dedicated to making a difference in the industry

Illumio is the leader in ransomware and breach containment, redefining how organizations contain cyberattacks and enable operational resilience. Powered by the Illumio AI Security Graph, our breach containment platform identifies and contains threats across hybrid multi-cloud environments – stopping the spread of attacks before they become disasters.

Recognized as a Leader in the Forrester Wave™ for Microsegmentation, Illumio enables Zero Trust, strengthening cyber resilience for the infrastructure, systems, and organizations that keep the world running.

Location: UK Remote or Netherlands Remote

Our Team's Vision:

Technical Account Managers

Technical Account Managers exist to help customers sustain and expand the technical value of their Illumio investment. We serve as strategic technical advisors to our customers, ensuring that Illumio’s segmentation platform is fully adopted, optimized, and operationalized to deliver sustained, measurable business value. Through proactive engagement, deep technical expertise, and continuous alignment to customer priorities and operating models, we drive measurable outcomes by accelerating adoption, advancing platform maturity, and enabling customers to realize the full operational value of their investment—reducing risk and operating with confidence at scale.

Technical Account Managers work in close partnership with Customer Success Advisors, Professional Services, Support, Sales, and Engineering to deliver a seamless customer experience. By identifying risks early, guiding technical decision-making, and advancing platform maturity, TAMs ensure customers not only achieve their initial objectives but are positioned to advance technical maturity, optimize adoption, and maximize the operational value of the platform.

Joining the Technical Account Manager team means becoming part of a highly collaborative organization focused on technical excellence, customer advocacy, and outcome-driven engagement. If you’re passionate about solving complex technical challenges, providing strategic technical guidance, and helping customers maximize the impact of their cybersecurity investments, you’ll have the opportunity to make a meaningful and lasting impact.

 

Your Impact:

  • Serve as strategic technical advisors to customer stakeholders by understanding their security objectives, customer priorities, operating model, risk profile, platform maturity, and business priorities.

  • Deliver structured TAM engagements that help customers fully adopt, optimize, and operationalize Illumio’s segmentation platform through onboarding support, adoption planning, operational reviews, value realization activities, and renewal or expansion readiness.

  • Translate platform telemetry, adoption signals, support trends, and customer feedback into actionable guidance that advances platform maturity, improves operational confidence, and delivers sustained, measurable business value.

  • Provide proactive strategic advisory by guiding technical decision-making for upgrades, architecture changes, policy evolution, feature adoption, and other critical decisions that support customer priorities and operating models.

  • Accelerate adoption and value realization by identifying adoption gaps, recommending enablement opportunities, supporting platform utilization reviews, and helping customers maximize the operational value of their Illumio investment.

  • Assess operational and environmental health through health reviews, support case analysis, incident pattern recognition, risk identification, and best-practice recommendations that help reduce risk and improve confidence at scale.

  • Strengthen customer resilience by identifying risks early, coordinating escalation management, documenting remediation actions, and helping customers reduce repeat operational friction.

  • Prepare and deliver executive-ready insights such as QBR content, impact reviews, adoption summaries, value realization updates, health assessments, and risk mitigation recommendations that demonstrate sustained technical and business value.

  • Partner closely with Customer Success Advisors, Professional Services, Support, Sales, Engineering, Product Management, and account teams to deliver a seamless customer experience and coordinated outcomes.

  • Travel up to 30% for customer engagements, executive reviews, team meetings, training, and field enablement, based on business need.

 

Your Toolkit:

  • Working knowledge of cybersecurity, Zero Trust, segmentation, enterprise infrastructure, security operations, or related environments that support customer adoption, optimization, and operationalization.

  • Demonstrated experience translating technical data, adoption metrics, platform signals, support trends, or customer feedback into practical recommendations that advance platform maturity and measurable outcomes.

  • Ability to communicate clearly with technical teams, executives, project owners, and cross-functional partners, including the ability to translate complex technical topics into business-relevant guidance tied to customer priorities.

  • Experience supporting customer-facing technical engagements such as adoption reviews, health checks, operational reviews, escalation management, implementation advisory, enablement sessions, or executive business reviews that help customers sustain and expand technical value.

  • Ability to learn new technologies, understand customer operating models, and guide customers through technical change with proactive planning, risk awareness, and follow-through.

  • Business acumen, consultative problem-solving skills, and the ability to connect technical recommendations to adoption, risk reduction, operational confidence, renewal confidence, expansion opportunities, and measurable business value.

  • Ability to work independently while coordinating effectively across Customer Success Advisors, Professional Services, Support, Sales, Engineering, Product Management, account teams, and field enablement teams.

  • Experience supporting enterprise software, SaaS platforms, cybersecurity solutions, infrastructure technologies, professional services, customer success, implementation, technical support, or other complex technical customer environments.

  • Relevant experience may come from full-time, part-time, consulting, contract, military, government, startup, enterprise, customer success, professional services, technical support, implementation, or other nontraditional career paths.

  • Comfort working within a defined delivery framework that uses standardized deliverables, platform maturity indicators, engagement cadence, and success measures to drive consistent, outcome-driven engagement.

 

Bonus Points:

  • Applied technical experience in engineering, science, computer science, cybersecurity, or related fields; formal education is welcome but not required when equivalent practical experience demonstrates the needed capability.

  • Knowledge of networking concepts such as routers, switches, load balancers, segmentation, firewalls, policy models, telemetry, logging, and enterprise security solutions.

  • Exposure to heterogeneous security environments—such as monitoring, alerting, SIEM, SOAR, ticketing, or operational workflow tools, is a plus, especially when paired with the ability to connect those tools to customer outcomes.

Mid Market Account Executive - DACH

Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:
Samsara is a fortress in a volatile market. We are a $2.1B ARR, NYSE-listed powerhouse that sells essential technology to the physical operations powering the global economy. This is a seat built for high performers and incredibly driven individuals who want to accelerate their careers. While many in the tech scene are scaling back, our DACH team continued to perform above 100% last year. We are looking for territory owners who want to manage deal cycles from €10k to €300k, selling a complex suite of 15+ products to 8 different personas, including MDs and Finance Directors. If you want to be pushed to your limit and rewarded, this is the place.

Whilst the role can be worked remotely anywhere in Germany or London, UK, there is a need to visit clients in the region as required (typically fortnightly basis).

You should apply if: 

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • Your mantra is #alwaysbeprospecting: The world of operations is vast. Your customers are often out in the field and the best way to catch them is live on the phone. Samsara's top reps do constant research to find companies and contacts to expand their pipeline.
  • You have innate curiosity in how businesses work: One day you'll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support in order to make a larger impact.
  • You are a life-long learner: Samsara sales are complex. You will need to learn about businesses where you previously had little knowledge. The payoff is big but you have to be willing to put in the work.
  • You build genuine relationships with your customers: The industries we serve have relied on pen-and-paper solutions for years and haven't been met with the type of technology we offer. Our customers value earned trust and human relationships built over time.
  • You want to be with the best: Samsara's high-performance Sales culture means you'll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before.

In this role you will:

    • Own your destiny: Operate as a pure revenue leader, responsible for 80-90% net-new logo acquisition through self-sourced pipeline.
    • Get In Early: The DACH Mid-Market is a high-achieving segment in the company. The window to build something significant is open right now. 
    • Sharpen Your Edge: Access elite enablement — Command the Message and MEDDPICC coaching — built to make you a more effective closer.

Minimum Requirements for the role:

  • Winning DNA: Minimum 18 months+ closing experience in an outbound-heavy SaaS environment. You must have a proven history of building your own pipe from scratch.
  • Over-achievement: A track record of hitting and exceeding quota in a competitive, complex environment
  • Strategic Grit: Experience managing multi-stakeholder deal cycles and technical POCs. We value your ability to hunt
  • Native German language speakers

Advantageous:

  • Intellectual Curiosity: You are eager to learn the inner workings of diverse industries, from waste management to food distribution, to better align our technology with their operational pain.
  • A Repeatable Sales Framework: You don't rely on luck or intuition. You have a structured methodology that delivers success and you understand that consistent, high-quality inputs lead to predictable results.
  • A Data-Minded Approach: You are a student of your own funnel. You understand how to structure your activity—prospecting volume, discovery depth, and multi-threading—to ensure a consistent output and forecast accuracy.
  • Continuous Process Iteration: You possess a relentless drive for self-improvement. You are someone who actively seeks feedback, iterates on their approach, and understands that evolving your tactics is the only way to stay ahead of the market.

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working 

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations 

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara's Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

jobs.title: Technical Project Manager - Engineering Delivery
jobs.description:
Technical Project Manager - Engineering Delivery

Diabolocom is looking for a Technical Project Manager to coordinate engineering delivery across our organization and work closely with the Head of Software Engineering on roadmap execution.

You will work across Engineering, Product, Infrastructure and Project teams to keep delivery on track, manage dependencies, identify risks early, and help turn delivery challenges into clear actions and decisions.

We are looking for someone with a software engineering background who has moved into technical leadership and genuinely enjoys the operational side of engineering.

The role

Our engineering organization includes around 90 engineers across 12 teams, working on a complex global product and multiple parallel initiatives.

This role combines ownership of our engineering delivery processes with hands-on execution. You will be responsible not only for running these processes, but also for continuously improving how we plan, coordinate and track delivery across the organization.

Process ownership

You will own and continuously improve:

  • engineering delivery planning processes
  • delivery tracking and reporting
  • cross-team coordination and dependency management.

You will build on our existing practices and ClickUp workflows, identifying what can work better and evolving the processes as the organization and product develop.

Delivery execution

Day to day, you will:

  • track delivery across teams and releases
  • coordinate dependencies and clarify ownership across teams
  • identify risks, blockers and delivery gaps early
  • challenge unclear timelines, priorities and commitments
  • coordinate next steps when delivery is at risk
  • provide clear visibility on delivery status and progress.

You will work closely with Engineering, Product, Infrastructure and Project teams to facilitate alignment.

The objective is simple: make software delivery predictable, transparent and effective.

What success looks like

First few weeks: You start taking ownership of delivery operations and become effective in coordinating ongoing delivery.

Within ~6-8 weeks: You understand the roadmap, teams, dependencies and delivery processes well enough to manage them confidently and start identifying opportunities for improvement.

Within 3 months: You operate autonomously across day-to-day engineering delivery coordination, bringing in the Head of Software Engineering when decisions or trade-offs require escalation.

Your work will directly influence our delivery efficiency and predictability: how much we can take on and how reliably we deliver what we commit to.

Who we are looking for

We are looking for someone who started in software engineering and moved into technical leadership, for example, an Engineering Manager, Technical Lead, senior Team Lead, or Technical Program Manager.

Titles matter less than scope. You need enough technical depth to understand architecture and dependencies, ask the right questions, and navigate complex delivery problems across teams.

We expect

  • around 10 years of experience in software engineering environments
  • at least 3 years in engineering or technical leadership
  • previous hands-on experience as a software engineer
  • experience leading or coordinating multiple engineering teams
  • a track record of delivering complex software initiatives and improving execution
  • strong understanding of the software development lifecycle, distributed systems and cross-team dependencies
  • understanding of Product Management fundamentals
  • experience with Agile and structured project management frameworks such as PMBOK or similar
  • strong prioritization, decision-making and communication skills
  • professional fluency in English.

French and Russian are nice to have.

This role will suit you if…

You still enjoy technical complexity, but what really motivates you is making execution work.

You like finding out why something is stuck and fixing it.

You genuinely enjoy the operational side of engineering: creating structure, improving processes, coordinating teams and making sure things get delivered.

You don’t just want to follow an established process. You naturally look for ways to make it work better.

You are comfortable working across multiple teams, asking difficult questions when needed, and bringing structure to situations where priorities, dependencies or timelines are not immediately clear.

Why Diabolocom

Diabolocom is building one of Europe’s most advanced AI-native CCaaS platforms, powering business-critical customer interactions for 400+ enterprise and mid-market customers across 60+ countries.

We combine a mature global CCaaS platform with a rapidly growing AI Product Suite, backed by our internal AI Research Lab and proprietary AI innovation.

Our ambition goes beyond adding AI features to an existing product. We are building toward a platform capable of orchestrating AI agents, human agents, business workflows and communication channels, with CCaaS as the execution layer.

For Engineering, this means working on the technical and operational challenges of an established enterprise product, from real-time communications and distributed systems to complex integrations, while contributing to its next generation.

With teams across Europe, the US, Brazil and the UAE, and an engineering organization of around 90 people, this role offers the opportunity to work on engineering delivery behind a global product used for critical customer operations.

Why this role

This is a hands-on role combining delivery execution with process ownership.

You will work with the Head of Software Engineering, Team Leads, Product, Infrastructure and Project teams, with a broad view of engineering delivery across the organization.

You will inherit established delivery practices, own them, and continuously improve how we plan, coordinate and track execution.

GM / VP Sales, France

Our Mission:

Omnea is the agentic operating system for procurement.

Procurement touches every pound a business spends, yet requests still stall for weeks and approvals get lost in inboxes. Our AI-first platform changes that: our agents capture requests, route approvals, onboard suppliers, flag risk and track every renewal, while anyone in the business can ask a question and get an answer grounded in their own company’s data. Buying becomes painless for everyone, procurement gets a seat at the table, and our customers have saved more than 100,000 hours of manual work so far.

Companies like Spotify, PayPal, T. Rowe Price, JustEat, Adyen and S&P Global run procurement on Omnea. We’re backed by $75M from Khosla Ventures, Insight Partners and Accel, and we’ve been named the UK’s number one startup in the Startups 100, ranked 11th on Sifted’s 2026 list of Europe’s fastest-growing companies, and recognised as one of Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies.

Talent density matters more to us than almost anything else. We keep the bar high in every team, so everyone here has real ownership and real impact. Our team is full of former founders and operators who’ve scaled unicorns, and we’re looking for people who want to do the best work of their careers alongside them.

Find out more about the team and life at Omnea here.

The role in one line

Come build our France territory. You'll own the market, lead from the front in every deal, and build the team as the market earns it.

Why now

Omnea is the UK's number one startup for 2026 and the 11th fastest-growing tech company in Europe. We're in the middle of a major global expansion, and France is a market we're committing to. The product, customers and sales motion are proven. What we need now is the leader who turns that into a real business on the ground.

  • We win 86% of live RFPs against our biggest competitor

  • More than 3x ARR growth in the last 12 months, with 40% in Q3 alone

  • Under 20% of enterprises use modern procurement software today. Gartner expects that to reach 50% by 2027

  • Global enterprises including Spotify, Wise, Adecco and McAfee already run on Omnea

What you'll do

  • Own the France number: set the territory plan, choose the target accounts and build pipeline from day one

  • Be in the deals: run and close our biggest France opportunities yourself, with CFOs, CPOs and procurement leaders

  • Lead from the front as Omnea's face in France: customer meetings, CFO dinners, industry events and partner conversations

  • Build the team as the market earns it: hire and coach the AEs who follow you, and set the standard they sell to

  • Take what you hear from buyers straight to product and marketing, so we win more in France

Who this is for

  • 8+ years in B2B SaaS, with a strong record of closing complex enterprise new business yourself

  • Experience leading or building a sales team, ideally in a new market or a fast-growing business

  • Fluent French and English

  • A player-coach who would rather be in the deal than in a dashboard

  • Credible with C-suite buyers, especially Finance, Procurement and Legal

  • Comfortable building from zero: no local team and no playbook handed to you, just a proven product and a market to win

  • Bonus: you've opened a new market or been an early leader at a scale-up

Where this goes

You'll build and lead Omnea's France business. As the market grows, so do your team and your remit. We run as a meritocracy, and we've signed the Future Founder Promise, so if you want to start your own company one day, we'll back that too.

How you'll work

This role is remote while we build our presence in France.

At Omnea, we embrace diversity. To build a product that's loved by everyone, we're best served by a team with all sorts of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We encourage you to apply even if your experience doesn't quite match the full job spec! And regardless of your race, religion, colour, gender, or anything else! If you think you could be a good fit for Omnea, please reach out.

A few things to note:

  • We offer competitive geo-localised benefits, and you can check out our UK Benefits Package here and our US Benefits Package here.

  • We work Tuesdays, Wednesdays & Thursdays in-person at our offices. At this early stage of our company life-cycle it's important to us that we get this together-time, and you can read more about why we believe this is a winning move here

  • We're commercial, ambitious and we don't pretend otherwise! We're actively seeking folks looking to make the most of a career-defining opportunity, with the hunger to be part of building something really impressive. You can see our values here and our Omnea Future Founder's fund here!

  • We sometimes use AI note-takers to help us transcribe interview notes, so we can be more present in your interview. If you'd like to opt out of us using automatic transcribers, please note this in the free text field in your application, otherwise we'll take your application as confirmation that you're happy for us to use notetakers (whether added to video calls or in the background).

We are proud to be recognised for both our culture and product, and we are just getting started. Join us as we grow!

jobs.title: Pentester Senior / Red Team
jobs.description:
Pentester Senior / Red Team

Ballpoint, c'est 7 consultants à Paris répartis en deux équipes : une équipe attaque pentest / Red Team, et une équipe défense avec le développement de Trapster. Nous sommes certifiés ISO 27001 et en cours de qualification PASSI.

Avec l'IA, notre métier a changé. Trouver une vulnérabilité n'a jamais été aussi accessible : les outils et la technique ne suffisent plus à faire la différence.

Ce qui compte aujourd'hui, c'est de comprendre l'entreprise qu'on attaque : son métier, ses actifs critiques, ce qui la mettrait vraiment à genoux. C'est pour ça que le Red Team est au cœur de ce qu'on fait : un attaquant réaliste, avec de vrais objectifs, face à une organisation et ses vrais enjeux.

Notre raison d'être : faire progresser durablement le niveau de sécurité de nos clients, pas seulement leur lister des failles.

Nous cherchons donc notre Responsable Pentest / Red Team : la personne qui construira notre pôle Red Team et fera grandir l'équipe.

Nos valeurs

Chez Ballpoint, on accompagne nos clients dans la durée : Red Team, pentest continu, retests. Nos consultants connaissent leur SI autant que leurs enjeux métier, et c’est ce qui guide notre façon de travailler.

1. Curiosité : l'art de creuser au-delà des outils

Nous cultivons la curiosité insatiable pour explorer des technologies inconnues et décortiquer les métiers de nos cibles, car c’est dans cette compréhension fine que se révèlent les chemins d’attaque les plus pertinents.

2. Chacun fait la différence

Chez nous, une bonne idée n’a pas de grade. Un script qui fait gagner une demi-journée sur chaque mission, une meilleure façon de présenter un finding au COMEX, une idée d’offre : chacun peut faire évoluer nos méthodes, nos outils et nos offres. Et on attend de chacun qu’il le fasse.

Le poste

Tu prends la responsabilité technique de toutes nos missions offensives, en restant sur le terrain. Rattaché directement au fondateur, tu travailles avec l'équipe pentest / Red Team.

  • Porter la qualité des missions : cadrage technique, méthodologie, relecture et validation des rapports avant livraison.

  • Mener les opérations Red Team de bout en bout : scénario, infrastructure d'attaque, évasion, débrief au COMEX.

  • Rester un pentester actif : web, Active Directory, mobile, industriel, sur une partie significative de ton temps.

  • Faire grandir l'équipe : montée en compétence des juniors, parcours de certification, partage des techniques.

  • Faire évoluer nos offres et nos outils : pentest continu, templates de rapport, outillage interne, veille.

  • Appuyer l'avant-vente : calls techniques avec les prospects et chiffrage des périmètres.

Ton profil

Tu as au moins 5 ans de pentest derrière toi, dont de vraies opérations Red Team, et l'envie de faire progresser une équipe.

Indispensable

  • Solide expérience en compromission Active Directory et en pentest web.

  • Opérations Red Team menées en conditions réelles : C2, contournement d'EDR, ingénierie sociale.

  • Un français écrit impeccable.

  • La capacité à expliquer une chaîne d'attaque à un RSSI comme à un directeur général.

  • Modalités de télétravail flexibles mais présence à Paris nécessaire.

  • Un bon feeling avec l'équipe : on passe beaucoup de temps ensemble, en mission comme au bureau, et l'ambiance compte autant que le niveau technique.

Un plus

  • Certifications offensives (OSCP, OSEP, CRTO, OSWE ou équivalent).

  • Expérience d'un cadre PASSI ou d'environnements sensibles.

  • CVE, articles, talks, outils open source.

Avantages

Tu rejoins une équipe de 7 consultants où tes choix techniques deviennent la norme, avec un accès direct au fondateur et une mission claire : faire évoluer notre pôle Red Team. Les missions sont variées (web, Active Directory, mobile, industriel…), et comme on suit nos clients dans la durée, tu vois l'impact réel de ton travail d'une année sur l'autre.

Ballpoint évolue vite, et tu en es un acteur direct. Tes idées ont un effet visible dès la semaine suivante, pas après six mois de comités.

  • Temps de R&D : du temps dédié à tes outils, à la recherche de vulnérabilités ou à la préparation d'un talk.

  • Formations et certifications : un budget annuel (OSEP, CRTO, OSWE…), passées sur ton temps de travail.

  • Télétravail : possible, avec 2 à 3 jours par semaine dans nos bureaux à Paris.

  • Les classiques : CDI cadre, mutuelle, prévoyance, transport, tickets restaurant.

Le process

C'est le fondateur qui gère ce recrutement de bout en bout. Pas de cabinet, pas de tri automatique : chaque candidature est lue et étudiée avec attention. Ça peut prendre un peu de temps, alors n'hésite pas à relancer.

At Deepgram, we expect an AI-first mindset—AI use and comfort aren’t optional, they’re core to how we operate, innovate, and measure performance.

jobs.title: Stage Frontoffice
jobs.description:
Stage Frontoffice

Wat ga je doen?

Een goede eerste indruk maken én jezelf ontwikkelen in gastvrijheid en communicatie? Daar krijg je tijdens jouw meewerkstage bij de Frontoffice volop de kans voor. Je bent een van de eerste aanspreekpunten voor bezoekers en bellers en leert hoe je hen vriendelijk en professioneel helpt. Je ontvangt gasten bij de receptie, neemt de telefoon op en voert verschillende administratieve werkzaamheden uit. Zo doe je in de praktijk ervaring op met receptiewerk, telefonie, hospitality, communicatie en administratie.

Omdat we internationaal werken, krijg je ook te maken met buitenlandse bezoekers en telefoongesprekken. Je hoeft natuurlijk nog geen perfecte Engelse gesprekken te voeren. Het belangrijkste is dat je het leuk vindt om Engels in de praktijk te gebruiken en hierin steeds beter te worden. Wanneer het rustiger is bij de Frontoffice, dan ondersteun je bij Travel. Je helpt bijvoorbeeld met de administratie rondom zakelijke reizen, het verwerken en controleren van reisgegevens en, waar mogelijk, het boeken van hotels en vluchten. Zo ontdek je niet alleen hoe de Frontoffice werkt, maar krijg je ook inzicht in het organiseren van zakelijke reizen.

Concreet ga je je bezighouden met:

  • Bezoekers ontvangen en leren hoe je zorgt voor een gastvrije en professionele ontvangst;

  • De telefoon aannemen en bellers doorverbinden of verder helpen;

  • Ervaring opdoen met Nederlandse én Engelse telefoongesprekken;

  • Werken met administratieve werkzaamheden en systemen;

  • Ondersteunen bij Travel, bijvoorbeeld bij het verwerken en controleren van reisgegevens;

  • Waar mogelijk helpen bij het boeken van hotels en vluchten voor zakelijke reizen;

  • Steeds zelfstandiger meedraaien in de dagelijkse werkzaamheden van de Frontoffice.

Het belangrijkste resultaat van jouw stage? Dat je steeds zelfstandiger kunt meedraaien bij de Frontoffice en jezelf verder ontwikkelt in gastvrijheid, communicatie en administratie. Daarnaast krijg je inzicht in Travel en leer je hoe de organisatie van zakelijke reizen er in de praktijk aan toegaat.


Wij vragen

  • Een mbo-opleiding in de richting van administratie, hospitality, toerisme of vergelijkbaar.

  • Je bent gastrvij en vindt het leuk om mensen te helpen;

  • Je werkt nauwkeurig en bent georganiseerd;

  • Je durft initiatief te nemen en bent leergierig;

Wij bieden

  • Een vergoeding: €600,- per maand;

  • Reiskostenvergoeding: zodat jij geen onnodige kosten maakt;

  • Apparatuur en materialen: bijvoorbeeld een laptop of software;

  • Ervaren coach: goede begeleiding is belangrijk en dus krijg je een vaste coach om je te ondersteunen;

  • Ruimte voor persoonlijke ontwikkeling.

Over Voortman

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer | Finance
jobs.description:
Forward Deployed Engineer | Finance

Jij zorgt dat AI niet bij een financiële pilot blijft, maar helpt in het echte werk.

Een slimme AI-demo maakt indruk. Maar pas als analisten en medewerkers er elke dag mee werken, wordt technologie waardevol. Zeker in finance, waar betrouwbaarheid, controleerbaarheid en regelgeving nooit bijzaak zijn.

Als Senior Forward Deployed AI Engineer ben je erbij vanaf het eerste gesprek. Je brengt "we willen iets met AI" binnen weken terug tot een use case die je kunt testen, of je zegt eerlijk dat het (nog) niet kan. Daarna ontwerp en bouw je de oplossing en breng je hem live in cycli van dagen. En dan maak je jezelf overbodig.

Wat ga je doen?

Je slaat de brug tussen business en techniek: je zit aan tafel bij de klant, ontwerpt de oplossing en implementeert vaak ook zelf.

  • Use cases scherp krijgen: samen met business development voer je discoverygesprekken, toets je use cases aan echte data en systemen en bouw je in dagen een proof-of-value.

  • Ontwerpen en uitvoeren: je ontwerpt de agentic architectuur, kiest per situatie het patroon dat past en brengt de oplossing in korte cycli naar productie, samen met onze AI Engineers.

  • Overdragen en meten: de klant kan de oplossing zelf draaien, en na go-live meet je of hij echt gebruikt wordt. Dát is je maatstaf.

  • Ons slimmer maken: wat je leert, maak je herbruikbaar voor de volgende klant, en je helpt nieuwe FDE's op weg.

Ongeveer 10% van je tijd gaat naar pre-sales en 90% naar delivery; business development is commercieel eigenaar.

Van KYC tot complexe financiële processen

Je kent de werkelijkheid achter KYC/AML, klantacceptatie, klachten- en schadeafhandeling, financiële rapportage, risk en compliance. Denk aan:

  • KYC-dossiers die agents voorbereiden met herleidbare bronnen, zodat analisten sneller onderbouwd beslissen.

  • Documenten en signalen die samenkomen voor een klachten- of schadeteam.

  • Rapportages die nu handwerk zijn, geautomatiseerd binnen de kaders van DORA en de EU AI Act.


Wat breng je mee?

  • Aantoonbare ervaring in finance: je kent de processen, data, systemen en risico's van binnenuit.

  • Je hebt AI-oplossingen met LLM's en agents ontworpen, in productie gebracht én onderhouden, inclusief evals, guardrails, monitoring en security.

  • Sterk in Python en SQL, en hands-on met minimaal één cloud (Azure, AWS of GCP) en een dataplatform zoals Databricks, Snowflake of Fabric.

  • Je werkt dagelijks met coding agents en beoordeelt kritisch wat ze opleveren.

  • Ervaring in een klantgerichte rol, zoals consultancy, pre-sales, solutions engineering of je eigen startup.

  • Je spreekt en schrijft vloeiend Nederlands en Engels.


Mooi meegenomen: ervaring met DORA, model risk management of audit trails, en met klassieke ML zoals fraude- en risicomodellen.

Wat dit níet is

  • Geen individuele detachering. Je werkt aan projecten namens adesso, met een team achter je.

  • Geen PoC-kerkhof. We bouwen om te gebruiken.

  • Geen slides zonder code. Je advies komt met een werkende versie.

  • Geen agent omdat het kan. Soms is de simpelste oplossing de beste, en dat zeg je dan.

Het team

Je wordt onderdeel van ons AI Engineering-team: AI engineering consultants in twee rollen. De Forward Deployed AI Engineer (FDE) is eigenaar van het klantprobleem en ontwerpt de oplossing, inclusief de agentic architectuur. De AI Engineer gaat de diepte in op bouw, data, MLOps en schaal, en denkt vanaf de klantvraag mee over de juiste aanpak.

Je krijgt ruimte om je eigen werk vorm te geven, maar je bent nooit alleen verantwoordelijk voor alle specialismen.

Twijfel je welke rol het best bij je past? Solliciteer dan gewoon; we kijken samen. 

Waarom adesso? Omdat je bij ons écht kunt meebouwen.

Bij adesso Nederland draait het om meer dan alleen technologie. We bouwen slimme oplossingen die daadwerkelijk waarde toevoegen voor onze klanten. Geen eindeloze experimenten of AI omdat het hip is, maar technologie die werkt en impact maakt.

We zijn onderdeel van de internationale adesso Group, met ruim 11.500 collega's op meer dan 60 locaties. Tegelijkertijd zijn we in Nederland een relatief klein en persoonlijk team, met korte lijnen, veel vrijheid en ruimte voor eigen initiatief.

Groot genoeg om impact te maken, klein genoeg om het verschil te voelen.

AI-native: wij omarmen AI, ook in ons eigen werk

We geloven dat AI fundamenteel verandert hoe we software bouwen, met data werken en klanten helpen. Daarom bouwen we niet aan losse experimenten, maar aan dataplatformen, AI-first applicaties en agentic oplossingen die echt onderdeel worden van bedrijfsprocessen.

Dat geldt ook voor hoe we zelf werken. Met onze Agentic Delivery-aanpak en eigen tools kun je echt vliegen:

  • Context en kennisbank: agents werken met wat er écht speelt bij de klant, en kennis en beslissingen blijven herleidbaar voor mens én agent.

  • AgentOps en governance: zicht op wat agents doen en controle over wat ze mogen, zodat ze veilig en binnen de regels werken.

  • adSCAILE: ons eigen framework waarmee je samen met AI-agents bouwt, geïntegreerd, veilig en traceerbaar, in cycli van twee tot vier dagen in plaats van sprints van weken.

Je gebruikt deze tools dagelijks en helpt ze verder te ontwikkelen. adesso is bovendien Select Partner in het Claude Partner Network van Anthropic. En we blijven kritisch: niet alles hoeft met AI. De beste oplossing staat altijd voorop.

En misschien wel het belangrijkste: de mensen

Je komt terecht in een team waar vakmanschap, ondernemerschap en kennisdeling centraal staan. Je werkt met ervaren specialisten en groeit door in technische visie en in verantwoordelijkheid voor klantrelaties.

We houden van collega's die nieuwsgierig zijn, kennis delen en elkaar verder helpen. Mensen die goed zijn in hun vak, maar ook plezier hebben in samenwerken. Je krijgt bij ons vertrouwen, verantwoordelijkheid en de vrijheid om ideeën daadwerkelijk uit te voeren.

Wat krijg je van ons?

  • €5.850–€7.150 bruto per maand op basis van 40 uur;

  • 8% vakantiegeld;

  • Contract voor 32 tot 40 uur per week;

  • Een leaseauto of mobiliteitsvergoeding naar keuze, bovenop je salaris;

  • 27 vakantiedagen en 4 studiedagen;

  • €3.600 persoonlijk ontwikkelbudget per jaar en ruimte voor certificeringen;

  • Hybride werken met flexibele werktijden;

  • Goede pensioenregeling;

  • Doorgroeimogelijkheden in een specialistenspoor;

  • Internationale kennis en ontwikkelmogelijkheden, gecombineerd met een hecht Nederlands team;

Zullen we kennismaken?

Je hoeft niet aan ieder technisch punt te voldoen. We zijn vooral benieuwd naar wat je hebt gebouwd, welke keuzes je hebt gemaakt en waar je naartoe wilt groeien.

Een cv of LinkedIn-profiel is genoeg om het gesprek te starten. Daarna volgen een kennismaking, een technisch gesprek en een praktijkcase.

Bij adesso werk je niet alleen aan de technologie van morgen. Je krijgt ook de ruimte om mee te bepalen hoe we die bouwen.
