jobs.title: Medior/Senior R&D Engineer Interoperability in Battle Labs & Experimentation (m/v/x/)
jobs.description:
Medior/Senior R&D Engineer Interoperability in Battle Labs & Experimentation (m/v/x/)

Ben jij een specialist op het gebied van computernetwerken en protocollen en heb je affiniteit met het toepassen van simulatie- en trainingssystemen in een R&D context? Wil jij werken in een innovatieve onderzoeksomgeving waar geavanceerde simulatoren en interoperabiliteit centraal staan? Dan zijn wij op zoek naar jou!

Wat ga je doen?

Als netwerk-expert binnen onze afdeling ben je verantwoordelijk voor onderzoek en ontwikkeling gericht op netwerken en systemen die verschillende simulatoren en operationele systemen veilig en efficiënt met elkaar verbinden. Je werkt aan vraagstukken met betrekking tot netwerkarchitecturen, (simulatie)protocollen zoals DIS en HLA, netwerkbeveiliging en schaalbaarheid van complexe simulatieomgevingen. Je levert een belangrijke bijdrage aan het mogelijk maken van interoperabiliteit tussen simulatoren, operationele systemen en autonome platforms, en bent betrokken bij de (door)ontwikkeling van zowel bestaande als nieuwe simulatienetwerken. In multidisciplinaire teams werk je samen met onder andere softwareontwikkelaars, domeinexperts en toekomstige eindgebruikers aan innovatieve oplossingen voor nationale en internationale stakeholders. Je bent hiervoor bereid om te reizen naar verschillende locaties, voornamelijk binnen Nederland.

Wat breng je mee?

Je bent iemand die in kansen denkt en nieuwsgierig is om bij te dragen aan oplossingen die werken in de praktijk. Je hebt heel makkelijk contact met eindgebruikers en kan hun wensen en ideeën snel in creatieve implementaties omzetten. Met je creatieve instelling maak je nieuwe technieken snel eigen en weet je deze te vertalen naar concrete resultaten!

Daarnaast:

  • Heb je een afgeronde bachelor of master opleiding in ICT, Computer Science, Informatica, Informatiekunde, of vergelijkbaar;

  • Heb je minstens 8 jaar relevante werkervaring, waarvan minstens 5 jaar ervaring op het gebied van netwerktechnologie, TCP/UDP, netwerkprotocollen, routering, switching en netwerkbeveiliging;

  • Beheers je meerdere programmeertalen zoals C, C++, C#, Java en ervaring in scripting om experimenteeromgevingen snel op te zetten of aan te passen;

  • Heb je interesse in experimenteren, wargaming en simulatie in een R&D-context;

  • Heb je ervaring met het ontwerpen en beheren van robuuste, schaalbare netwerkomgevingen;

  • Ben je bereid om je te verdiepen in (militaire) luchtvaartoperaties;

  • Werk je graag samen, durft je te experimenteren en kan je technische keuzes uitleggen aan niet-technische collega’s;

  • Kan jij je in de Nederlandse en Engelse taal zowel mondeling als schriftelijk uitstekend uitdrukken.

Nice to have:

  • Ervaring met of interesse in simulatie- en interoperabiliteitsprotocollen (DIS/HLA/FOMs);

  • Ervaring met het opzetten van tijdelijke of experimentele infrastructuren;

  • Kennis van netwerkbeveiliging of VPN-oplossingen;

  • Ervaring met monitoring- of observabilitytools;

  • Interesse in nieuwe technologieën zoals autonome systemen, AI in simulatie of digitale twins.

Wat bieden wij jou?

Werken bij NLR, betekent werken in een nationale en internationale hightech omgeving. Samenwerken en betrokkenheid staan bij ons hoog in vaandel. Door jou vrijheid en eigen verantwoordelijkheid te geven, ben jij het best in staat om tot baanbrekende innovaties te komen. Wil jij jezelf vakinhoudelijk én op persoonlijk vlak ontwikkelen? Ook dat kan bij NLR als lerende organisatie, met daarnaast een opleidingsbudget, een mentor, interne coaches en goede contacten met mbo’s, hbo’s en universiteiten.

Naast dit alles bieden wij jou:

  • De kans om bij te dragen aan complexe en maatschappelijk relevante vraagstukken;

  • Een bruto maandsalaris tussen € 4330,- en € 7000,- (bij fulltime dienstverband), afhankelijk van je kennis en ervaring;

  • 45 verlofdagen (bij fulltime dienstverband);

  • 8% vakantiegeld én een vaste eindejaarsuitkering van 8%;

  • De kosten voor reizen met het openbaar vervoer worden volledig vergoed. Reis je met eigen vervoer? Dan ontvang je een kilometervergoeding voor woon-werkverkeer;

  • Een zorgtoelage via onze collectieve zorgverzekering bij OHRA als extra ondersteuning voor jouw zorgkosten;

  • Extra betaald ouderschapsverlof;

  • Een goede pensioenregeling

Jouw nieuwe werkomgeving

Bij de afdeling Training & Simulatie werken op dit moment rond de 100 deskundigen op het gebied van simulatie, informatica, training, luchtvaart en psychologie. Binnen onze projecten wordt multidisciplinair samengewerkt, zowel binnen als buiten het NLR. De afdeling beschikt over allerlei onderzoeksfaciliteiten zoals een battlelab en simulatoren voor gevechtsvliegtuig- en onbemande systemen en een laboratorium dat zich richt op AR/VR innovaties. Een plezierige werkomgeving vinden we essentieel. De sfeer binnen de afdeling is informeel en collegiaal en we vinden het belangrijk dat iedereen zich thuis kan voelen bij ons.

Wat betekent werken bij NLR?

Koninklijke NLR is al ruim 100 jaar een kennisorganisatie met de wil en ambitie om te vernieuwen. Vanuit die drijfveer maken wij de wereld van lucht- en ruimtevaart veiliger, duurzamer, efficiënter en effectiever en staan wij voor baanbrekende innovaties.

Bij ons werken bijna 1000 gedreven professionals, van vliegtuigbouwkundigen tot psychologen en van wiskundigen tot applicatiedeskundigen. NLR staat voor een inclusieve en diverse organisatie waar iedereen zich welkom, veilig, gewaardeerd en gerespecteerd voelt.

Wil jij meer weten?

Bel of mail dan met Pien Moller (recruiter) via 0611443915 of Onze collega’s vertellen jou graag hoe het is om bij NLR te werken. Vergeet trouwens ook niet eens een kijkje op onze socials te nemen zoals ons YouTube kanaal.

Solliciteren?

Mooi, we zijn benieuwd naar jou! Stuur je motivatiebrief en CV via de ‘Solliciteren’ button.

 

Een positieve uitkomst van een veiligheidsonderzoek (VGB) is een voorwaarde voor indiensttreding. Meer informatie daarover lees je op de website van de MIVD.

Acquisitie wordt niet op prijs gesteld!

jobs.title: Product & Technical Communications
jobs.description:
Product & Technical Communications

About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

You'll be responsible for:

  • Developing and articulating our long-term vision for the future of human-AI interaction, and what we’re building for developers and businesses.

  • Shaping the narrative around our products (in particular ElevenAgents), connecting our capabilities to emerging needs and trends in the wider world.

  • Leading storytelling and communications for top tier product launches, in partnership with product marketing, and running campaigns between launches to demonstrate the value our platform delivers.

  • Owning our security, privacy, and safety communications, including managing incident responses as part of a cross-functional team.

  • Producing superb written materials that advance our product story – including keynotes, talk tracks, social posts, and press releases – and creating scrappy product demos to show our technology in action.

  • Building the profile of our technical and product leadership, developing novel points of view, and supporting them with media, social, and event appearances.

  • Nurturing relationships with journalists, Substack writers, podcasters, technical creators, and other influencers who shape developer and enterprise buying decisions.

Requirements

We are looking for someone who has:

  • Run product or technical comms at a fast-paced B2B technology company, or built AI / software products.

  • A record of leading significant launches, and running effective product campaigns in between them.

  • Exceptional writing across different formats, with a talent for turning complex, technical topics into sticky narratives.

  • Experience working with security, safety, and engineering teams, and managing incidents.

  • Deep understanding of the independent media landscape and good relationships with some of the most influential commentators.

  • A track record of excellence, be that building products, running superb campaigns, or some other entrepreneurial endeavor.

Location

This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere on the US East Coast, with the ability to operate in GMT-5 to GMT-4 timezones required. If you prefer, you can work from our New York office.

#LI-Remote

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

jobs.title: Web Designer at AIOS — Remote, $75k-$150k/yr (including equity)
jobs.description:
Web Designer at AIOS — Remote, $75k-$150k/yr (including equity)

About AIOS

AIOS is building the world’s first full-stack AI doctor.

We’re at $450M ARR, growing from $7M/yr in April 2025. We’re faithfully serving >200k/mo patients via Bolt Pharmacy, our main UK brand. We’ve just launched Bolt Med, our international brand. We’re profitable.

Our strategy exists at the intersection of two strong theses:

  1. The AI doctor that wins will get to escape velocity using GLP-1s, the fastest growing consumer product in history.

  2. The $2T European healthcare market is overlooked by the most talented builders.

Our master plan:

  • Step 0 → $100M/yr by end of 2025: We went from $10M to $100M in 6 months serving the UK GLP-1 market.

  • Step 1 → $1B ARR by end of 2026: Since April 2025 we've grown from 3k to 200k UK active GLP-1 patients. We’ll continue this growth curve to hit $1B ARR.

  • Step 2 → $10B ARR by end of 2028: Blitzscale Europe. We’ll be Europe’s largest GLP-1 provider.

  • Step 3 → $100B/yr by end of 2030: Get regulatory approval across Europe for our Full Autonomous Prescribing (FAP) system. Win contracts at scale with European payers to mass replace human labor. We’ll be the dominant full-stack AI doctor in Europe.

  • Step 4 → $1T/yr by end of 2035: With one line of code and zero human time, you can use AIOS to treat any patient globally with any medication.

In so doing, we’ll become the world’s first trillion-dollar healthcare company.

We’re a young, founder-led company. This is still Day 1 and all our work is ahead of us.

You can read more about working with us here: Working at AIOS

Being a Web Designer at AIOS

We’re building a world-class team.

As Web Designer at AIOS, you’ll own how our brands look and perform on the web, and you’ll own the outcome, not just the pixels. We expect you to do much more than design the website. You’ll find the insight, shape the offer, design the page, build it, ship it and learn from the results.

Flashy design isn’t the job. Getting people to act is. Every page you make should help a real person take the next step towards treatment that can change their life.

You’ll design landing pages, funnels, quizzes and onboarding flows across Bolt Pharmacy, Bolt Med and the new markets we’re launching. You’ll lean on AI to design, build and test at a pace a traditional team can’t match.

This is a full-time, fully remote role, and you’ll work mostly async in the timezone of your choice, as long as you’re around until midday Pacific Time every weekday.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role. You’ll report directly to Ryan Wu, our Head of Design. You’ll work closely with Michael McCann, our CRO Lead.

You’ll sit within the Growth team, which is currently led by our CEO (Richie). I (Richie) intense, so you’ll also be intense. You’ll work long days and regularly work weekends.

This is an awful job for the vast majority of people looking for a job. Stay away! And for the right person, this will be the best role of your life :)

Key responsibilities

You’ll own web conversion end to end, from insight through to live page. This role exists to turn growth bets into high-converting pages, fast.

  • Strategic ownership: Own the outcome, not the artefact. Spot what’s holding conversion back, form a point of view, make the case and see it through. We want you shaping what we build, not just how it looks.

  • High-converting web design: Design websites, landing pages, funnels and onboarding flows that get people to act. Clear hierarchy, sharp copy flow and a strong offer beat decoration every time.

  • Value propositions: Turn what we know about our patients into compelling USPs and value propositions, then test which ones land.

  • Follow the scent: Take the scent trails you’re given (data, research, CRO insights, a hunch from the founders) and turn them into high-converting designs, with a high degree of autonomy.

  • Figma to live: Get your designs out of Figma and into frontend code yourself. We currently use Webflow. No handoff queue, no waiting on a developer.

  • AI-powered design and build: Use AI to design, build and generate A/B tests and landing pages. Prompt your way to high-quality work rather than doing it all by hand.

  • Systems that scale: Build and improve the AI workflows, components and templates that let one designer do the work of a whole team, while keeping brand quality high.

  • Ship fast: Go from idea to live test in days, not weeks. Read the results, cut what doesn’t work and double down on what does.

Need to have

  • Experience: 3+ years designing high-performing websites and landing pages, with a portfolio that shows results, not just visuals.

  • User psychology: A strong understanding of what motivates people to convert, and how hierarchy, copy, proof and friction shape a decision.

  • Value propositions: Able to craft compelling USPs and value propositions, and put them on a page so they land.

  • Design to code: Comfortable moving your own designs into frontend code. Webflow experience is helpful but not essential.

  • AI-native: At the forefront of AI in design. You already use it in your day-to-day workflow, you’re strong at building AI systems that scale your output, and you’re keen to push adoption further.

  • Ownership: Self-directed and happy to own work from insight through to live page. You don’t wait for direction, you find what’s missing and fix it.

  • Speed: You ship fast without dropping quality. You’d rather get something live and learn than polish it in Figma for another week.

  • Craft: High standards for polish, spacing, responsiveness and load speed.

Nice to have

  • CRO: Experience running or designing for A/B and multivariate tests.

  • Analytics: Comfortable reading performance data and using behaviour tools to decide what to try next.

  • Product flows: Experience with onboarding, checkout or other key conversion touchpoints.

  • Regulated markets: Experience designing for healthcare, pharmacy or other regulated industries.

  • Design Systems : Experience building or maintaining component-based systems for testing and scale.

  • Multi-market: Experience adapting pages for different countries and languages.

  • SEO and performance: Understanding of how design choices affect SEO and page speed.

Our cultural standards

We aim to make this your life's work. This should be the most challenging, most rewarding role of your life. Accordingly, these are the core cultural standards to which we hold ourselves & our team-members:

  1. Belief in the mission: We will have served 100 million patients by the end of 2035 and we transform the life of most patients who join. We have a lot of work to do. We are obsessed with our patients and are dedicated to the mission.

  2. Unwavering integrity: We are at the frontier, so we often live in ambiguity with no trodden path. When we can't look to others for guidance, we must maintain impeccable ethics and unwavering integrity.

  3. Only the paranoid survive: Bad sh*t is coming. By joining us, you're choosing to sail straight towards the storms with unhesitating conviction. However much we've already done, however far we've already come, it's still Day 1 and all our work is ahead of us.

  4. If we're average we fail: We are only interested in "insanely great", a focus on the quality of our execution that in everyday life would be considered pathological. We have a dedication to excellence and reject incompetence.

  5. Commitment to candor: That which can be destroyed by the truth should be. You get full transparency from the company and the company expects full transparency from you. We never say anything about someone that we wouldn't say to them directly. We give feedback with love and do not need to protect people from fleeting physical sensations.

  6. A maniacal sense of urgency: We execute at an intensity that most people think is impossible. Speed is critical and we need things done yesterday. We all work very hard and in such a competitive world there really is no other way to win.

  7. Enduring frugality: We are frugal. We hate being wasteful and we are anti-luxury. A culture of cheapness keeps us young. We spend our cash wisely & carefully, in a way that would make our grandmas proud.

  8. Bulldozing barriers: The world is malleable and we shape it. We truly believe this and act accordingly. We are relentlessly resourceful and are at the mercy of no-one but ourselves. You'll be shocked how capable you are and how much you can achieve.

  9. Keep your head down: We're boring people doing exciting work. We don't chase short-term status. We ignore short-term dopamine hits and focus on what matters. Outsiders will underestimate us and we revel in that.

  10. The power of focus: We live in a world of power laws and we cannot overestimate the unimportance of practically everything. Know your One Thing, and nail it.


🎯

"You just build a f\*ing amazing experience. Make each step amazing. Make every decision in the long term interest of the customer. Give the customer massively more value than you take."

Compensation & Benefits

You get paid above market salary and you get early stage equity, so you get really rich if we nail this.

  • Compensation: $75k-$150k/yr including equity

Benefits

The stuff below is cool as well.

  • Healthcare: comprehensive medical insurance (if appropriate).

  • Remote: our team is fully distributed across the world and functions fully remotely.

  • Personal development: budget for books, courses, coaching.

  • Personal wellness: budget for gym, health apps.

  • GLP-1s: free membership with a clinic offering GLP-1s.

  • Health coaching: free biweekly health coaching so you stay healthy.

  • Work coaching: free biweekly work coaching so you stay sharp + calm.

  • Equipment: Macbook & work-from-home equipment provided as needed.

  • What are we missing? We're still early so you get to shape our culture.

How to apply

Apply via Ashby and be sure to include:

  • your resume and portfolio

  • 2 or 3 live pages you designed and shipped, and what happened to conversion

  • a short note on how you use AI in your design and build workflow today

jobs.title: Assistant Financial Controller
jobs.description:
Assistant Financial Controller

About Flock

Road accidents kill and injure people, damage vehicles, and cost businesses fortunes. But traditional insurance does nothing to prevent them - it just pays out claims when they happen. At Flock, we’re changing that. Using telematics, AI, and real-time data, we proactively help our fleet customers prevent crashes. We obsessively focus on keeping drivers safe, and we put our money where our mouth is - paying out millions of pounds per year to fleets that get safer over time.

We were acquired by Admiral in May 2026. Now we combine the backing of the UK’s leading motor insurer with startup energy and speed. We’re growing fast with bigger plans than ever, and we’re hugely optimistic that our approach will save many more lives in the decade ahead.

We’re on a mission to make the world quantifiably safer. Join us!

 

About the role

Reporting to Sarah Phillips, you’ll own month-end for Flock’s finance team and strengthen the controls around it, running the close and producing the variance analysis and MI that FP&A and our senior team use for budgeting and reporting. We’re automating finance on our new platform and the team uses AI every day, so there’s plenty of room to improve how the work gets done as well as doing it.

It suits a recently qualified accountant with strong core accounting from practice, who has already improved a process or control somewhere and wants to keep growing within the finance team.

 

What you’ll be doing

  • Own the month-end close from start to finish so it lands accurately and on time.

  • Prepare balance sheet reconciliations and post journals, keeping the ledger clean and well evidenced.

  • Run variance analysis and build the monthly MI pack, explaining what moved and why.

  • Strengthen our financial controls and automate manual steps wherever you find them.

  • Prepare our VAT returns and assist with group reporting.

  • Work with FP&A so the numbers behind budgets and senior reporting are right.

  • Support the annual audit and work alongside our external auditors.

  • Use AI tools in your daily work to speed up reconciliations, analysis and reporting, and share what works with the team.

  • Pick up ad hoc finance projects, including R&D tax claims if you have the experience.

 

What you’ll need

  • An ACA qualification, ideally recently qualified, although we’ll also consider strong ACCA or CIMA candidates.

  • A practice background with hands-on month-end experience, whether from non-audit client work or time in industry. Big 4 or not makes no difference to us.

  • Solid core accounting and close attention to detail, including balance sheet reconciliations, journals and variance analysis.

  • Experience strengthening financial controls or improving a finance process, with an example you can talk us through.

  • Curiosity and ambition, with the drive to push things forward and keep learning.

  • An interest in AI. You don’t need to be an expert, but you should already be using it at work or in your own time and want to do more with it.

Nice to have:

  • Audit experience.

  • Experience using NetSuite.

  • Experience automating finance processes.

  • Exposure to R&D tax claims.

  • Experience in the tech sector.

 

Benefits

  • 25 days of holiday (+ Bank Holidays) 🏖

  • Share Incentive Plan 📈

  • Workplace Pension 💰

  • Private Medical Insurance 🏥 (including Dental 🦷 Optical 👓 & Mental Health 💆‍♀️ support options)

  • Various Salary Sacrifice Schemes - Holiday Purchase, Tech, Gym, Cycle to Work, Electric Vehicle, Private Medical Insurance for families 💵

  • Enhanced Parental Leave and Pay 🐣

  • £1000 toward relevant professional qualifications 🎓

  • £500 per annum towards learning and development 🌱

  • 3 days paid leave for L&D purposes 🌻

We work hybrid, typically three days a week in our Central London office (fewer office days can be accommodated for longer commute times), a few minutes from Moorgate and Liverpool Street. Visits to client sites, conferences and broker offices count towards office days.

 

Making the world quantifiably safer takes more than good data. It takes a team where different perspectives are heard, and that’s a priority here. We insure fleets and drivers from every background, and we know a team built the same way makes sharper decisions and a better product for our customers. So we hire on merit, full stop, and we actively encourage applications from everyone. If you don’t tick every box, apply anyway. Just come as your genuine self: the qualities and experiences only you bring are exactly what we want.

jobs.title: Partner Account Manager - France
Forward Deployment Strategist
jobs.description:
Forward Deployment Strategist

À propos de nAIxt Consulting / ILLUIN Technology

nAIxt Consulting est la practice conseil d'ILLUIN Technology, société née en 2017 au cœur de CentraleSupélec, l'un des clusters IA de référence en Europe. Spécialisée dans l'IA appliquée dans les entreprises (grands groupes, comptes publics, ETI, PME), ILLUIN est pionnière du NLP francophone et mène ses propres recherches en IA générative. Nos consultants interviennent en immersion chez le client pour déployer des solutions IA à fort impact (assistants conversationnels, automatisation documentaire, analyse de données), avec la vision agnostique des technologies IA (solutions du marché, produits Illuin, des approches sur mesure).

Le rôle

Nous recherchons plusieurs Forward Deployed Strategist (FDS) pour rejoindre nôtre équipe. Dans ce rôle, vous portez la stratégie d'intégration des solutions IA (de l’automatisation des tâches ponctuelles à la vision Agentic), l'adoption et l'orchestration des transformations IA, en collaboration avec les Forward Deployed Engineers (FDE). Immergé chez le client, vous faites le lien entre les décideurs, les métiers et les équipes de delivery pour transformer le potentiel de l'IA en usages réels et mesurables.

Vous pilotez la transformation IA d'un périmètre métier. Vous construisez la stratégie d'adoption, orchestrez les acteurs (direction, métiers, IT, Data) et garantissez un impact mesurable, du cadrage des cas d'usage jusqu'à l'ancrage des nouveaux usages.

Vos missions

Stratégie & cadrage

  • Construire la feuille de route IA d'un périmètre métier et la faire vivre

  • Qualifier et prioriser le portefeuille de cas d'usage selon la valeur, la faisabilité et les risques

  • Concevoir les processus cibles intégrant l'IA et les agents, et définir les interactions entre l'humain et l'IA

  • Construire les business cases et les critères Go / No Go avec les décideurs

  • Identifier dès le cadrage les prérequis de sécurité, de gouvernance et de qualité des données

  • Éclairer les arbitrages entre produits existants et développements sur mesure (Make vs Buy)

Orchestration de la transformation

  • Dialoguer d'égal à égal avec le Delivery Manager sur l'avancement, les risques et les arbitrages priorité/délai/périmètre

  • Être en mesure d'assurer un pilotage projet de bout en bout sur des missions à faible volumétrie ne justifiant pas un Delivery Manager dédié

  • Aligner direction, métiers, IT et Data autour d'objectifs et d'un plan partagés

  • Séquencer les déploiements pour que chaque cas d'usage renforce le suivant

  • Planifier les déploiements, anticiper les dépendances et lever les blocages

  • Piloter le passage des pilotes à l'échelle avec les équipes de delivery ILLUIN

  • Préparer et animer les instances de pilotage (Coproj, Copil)

Adoption & conduite du changement

  • Concevoir la stratégie d'adoption (formation, communication, relais métiers, rituels)

  • Construire les plans de montée en compétences

  • Installer et animer des réseaux d'ambassadeurs IA chez le client

  • Identifier les résistances et mettre en place les réponses adaptées

Impact & mesure

  • Définir et suivre les KPIs d'adoption et d'impact (taux d'usage, temps gagné, qualité, économies opérationnelles)

  • Mesurer les résultats et les présenter aux décideurs en comitologie

  • Mettre en place les dispositifs de retours utilisateurs et d'amélioration continue

  • Ajuster la trajectoire de déploiement selon les signaux terrain

Vie du cabinet

  • Encadrer et faire progresser des consultants juniors en mission

  • Contribuer à la prospection commerciale, aux propositions et aux soutenances

  • Capitaliser les retours d'expérience et enrichir les méthodologies et playbooks du cabinet

Working at the intersection of advanced AI research and practical software engineering, you will transform complex operational workflows into reliable, scalable production solutions.
You will establish robust evaluation, testing, and observability frameworks to ensure AI-powered systems deliver predictable and measurable results.
You will also explore innovative ways to integrate coding agents and specialized subagents into software development processes.
Collaborating closely with product and operational teams, you will identify high-impact automation opportunities and translate them into effective technical solutions.
As an early core member of the engineering team, you will have significant influence over architectural decisions, technical standards, and the long-term AI strategy.

  • Develop reusable AI infrastructure that enables new workflows to be introduced quickly, consistently, and with predictable reliability.

  • Build comprehensive evaluation frameworks to measure agent performance, identify failure points, and understand the factors behind successful outcomes.

  • Actively use agentic engineering tools and workflows in daily development activities.

  • Design architectures that enable specialized AI agents, tools, deterministic software, and human expertise to work together effectively.

jobs.description:
Senior IT & Cybersecurity Auditor

We are currently looking for an experienced Senior IT & Cybersecurity Auditor to join an international financial services environment and contribute to strengthening its technology, cybersecurity and risk management landscape.

In this role, you will combine your technical expertise with a strong understanding of governance, risk and controls. You will take ownership of complex audit engagements, challenge existing practices and provide independent insights that support informed decision-making at senior management level.

This is an excellent opportunity for a technically experienced professional who enjoys investigating complex IT environments, identifying potential vulnerabilities and making a meaningful impact on the organisation’s security and resilience.

Responsibilities & Tasks

  • Plan, lead and deliver comprehensive IT audit engagements based on a risk-oriented approach, including the development of audit strategies and testing procedures.

  • Review and evaluate technology-related risk areas, including cybersecurity, IT governance, infrastructure, network security, access management, data protection, operational resilience and emerging technologies.

  • Apply your technical background to analyse complex IT architectures, identify potential weaknesses and assess the effectiveness of existing security measures and internal controls.

  • Review findings from penetration tests, vulnerability scans, security assessments and monitoring activities, translating technical observations into relevant risk insights.

  • Assess emerging technologies, particularly Artificial Intelligence and AI-driven solutions, and evaluate their implications for cybersecurity, governance and technology risk.

  • Present audit findings, recommendations and risk assessments to relevant stakeholders, including senior management and executive-level decision-makers.

  • Prepare structured and impactful audit documentation, ensuring that identified issues are clearly communicated and actionable.

  • Track remediation activities and evaluate the effectiveness of implemented measures.

  • Work closely with colleagues across IT, Cybersecurity, Risk Management, Governance and Business functions to promote continuous improvement and strengthen the overall control environment.

Requirements & Qualifications

  • Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Information Systems or a comparable discipline, alternatively equivalent professional experience.

  • At least 10 years of relevant professional experience in IT, Cybersecurity, Information Security, Technology Risk or a related technical field.

  • Strong practical knowledge of several core technology and security domains, such as Network Security, Identity and Access Management, Vulnerability Management, Security Operations or IT Resilience.

  • Experience working with technical security assessments, penetration testing results, vulnerability scanning solutions or comparable security tools.

  • Previous exposure to IT Audit, Internal Audit, External Audit, Technology Risk or another assurance-related function is highly desirable.

  • Professional certifications such as CISA, CISM, CISSP or equivalent qualifications are considered an advantage.

  • Interest in Artificial Intelligence, machine learning and AI-driven technologies, particularly in relation to security, governance and risk management. Practical experience in AI governance or AI-based solutions is beneficial.

  • Strong analytical capabilities, a structured approach to problem-solving and the ability to assess complex technical information independently.

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the confidence to challenge established practices constructively and engage with senior decision-makers.

  • High professional integrity, sound judgement and a strong sense of responsibility.

  • Fluent English is required. German and/or French language skills are an additional advantage.

  • Willingness to undertake international business travel, approximately 20 days or more annually.

Benefits & Culture

  • Work in an international financial services environment where technology, security and risk management play a central role.

  • Take on a highly visible position with direct exposure to senior stakeholders and strategic decision-making.

  • Enjoy a broad and varied scope of responsibility across technology, cybersecurity and emerging risk areas.

  • Collaborate with experienced professionals from IT, Business, Risk and Governance in a supportive and knowledge-driven environment.

  • Benefit from opportunities for continuous professional development, specialist training and relevant industry certifications.

  • Contribute to meaningful initiatives that strengthen organisational security, resilience and governance.

  • Join a professional culture that values integrity, initiative, collaboration and individual expertise.

jobs.title: Expansion Associate (H/F) - 100%
jobs.description:
Expansion Associate (H/F) - 100%

Tu n'abandonnes pas au premier refus, ni au dixième. Tu traites une liste le vendredi après-midi avec le même soin que le lundi matin, et tu mènes à terme ce que tu as commencé, pour que rien ne reste en suspens et que rien ne vieillisse en silence dans un coin. Tu n'as besoin de personne derrière ton épaule pour tenir ton niveau d'exigence. Et quand un cas ne rentre pas dans le processus, tu le signales au lieu de bricoler une solution.

Si tu te reconnais dans ces lignes, tu es au bon endroit.

En tant qu'Expansion Associate, tu es le chasseur ou la chasseuse d'appartements de Room Estate en Suisse romande, avec un accent sur Genève. Tu es responsable de l'acquisition d'appartements de A à Z : tu passes le marché au crible, tu évalues chaque appartement sous l'angle du coliving, tu le visites sur place, tu postules en notre nom, tu relances et tu accompagnes le dossier jusqu'à la signature du bail. C'est un rôle pour les personnes qui passent à l'action, et c'est précisément sa force : fréquence, ténacité et sens des responsabilités dans un processus clairement défini. Notre principe directeur : la croissance naît d'un tri des annonces à haute fréquence, d'une évaluation rigoureuse et de relances systématiques, pas de coups de chance. Tu travailles en étroite collaboration avec notre responsable de l'équipe Acquisition, qui tranche les cas d'appréciation, et ton travail se mesure à ce qui compte au final : les chambres acquises, les baux signés et la qualité de ce que tu ramènes.

Tasks

  • Tu passes les portails immobiliers au crible de manière systématique, chaque jour et avec un regard sûr pour ce qui convient.

  • Tu évalues chaque appartement sous l'angle du coliving : plan, état, immeuble, et la question de savoir si la propriété est prête à jouer le jeu.

  • Tu organises les visites et tu te rends sur place pour vérifier sur l'objet réel ce que promet l'annonce.

  • Tu postules en notre nom et tu positionnes Room Estate comme le locataire que toute régie souhaite avoir.

  • Tu relances jusqu'à ce qu'une décision soit prise. Aucun dossier ne s'enlise.

  • Tu accompagnes le dossier jusqu'à la signature et tu contrôles le bail à l'aide de notre liste de contrôle : points critiques, clauses manquantes et écarts par rapport à l'annonce.

  • Tu tiens le suivi des dossiers à jour : chaque objet saisi, chaque statut traçable.

Requirements

  • Sens des responsabilités et autonomie. Tu fais avancer un processus de bout en bout à une fréquence élevée et à un rythme fiable, tu vas au bout de chaque suivi et tu ne laisses aucun dossier s'enliser. C'est le cœur de ce rôle.

  • Maîtrise du français, à l'écrit comme à l'oral, dans les échanges avec les régies et les propriétaires.

  • Ténacité et sens de la négociation, le marché locatif genevois dit souvent non, et cela ne te déstabilise pas.

  • Un œil pour les plans, tu vois d'emblée si le coliving fonctionne dans un appartement et combien de chambres sont réalistes.

  • Rigueur dans le travail avec des listes de contrôle, tu vas au bout de chaque point plutôt que de faire les choses à peu près, et tu repères les écarts. Aucune connaissance spécialisée en droit du bail n'est requise.

  • Permis de conduire catégorie B et disponibilité pour des visites régulières à Genève, dans la région lémanique et dans le reste de la Suisse romande.

  • Anglais courant, à l'écrit comme à l'oral, notre langue de travail interne.

BONUS

  • Expérience dans le secteur immobilier suisse (formation en gérance immobilière, cours USPI, activité de courtage)

  • Réseau existant auprès des régies et des propriétaires à Genève et dans la région lémanique

  • Expérience dans l'univers du coliving ou des appartements meublés avec services

  • Connaissances de base du droit du bail suisse

  • Allemand

Benefits

  • Salaire fixe plus bonus progressif pour chaque chambre acquise, sans plafond : plus tu acquiers de chambres, plus tu gagnes par chambre.

  • Bureau à Lausanne, avec la possibilité de télétravailler certains jours

  • Équipement de ton choix (ordinateur portable, écran, accessoires)

  • Des processus et des listes de contrôle documentés, et un·e responsable d'équipe à qui reviennent les exceptions, pour que tu puisses faire ta part avec précision au lieu d'improviser

  • Un rôle qui t'appartient : tu ne fais pas partie d'une équipe d'acquisition, tu es l'acquisition en Suisse romande

  • Une équipe internationale et solidaire, avec une vraie culture de l'apprentissage

  • Budget de formation continue (cours, livres, conférences)

  • Une vraie évolution : ton ambition détermine jusqu'où tu iras, tes résultats à quelle vitesse. Ton périmètre de responsabilité grandit avec les deux.

Chez Room Estate, tu bénéficies de vraies responsabilités et d'un feedback direct, sans micromanagement ni langue de bois. On se tutoie, on se dit les choses, et nous sommes exigeants : tu as le droit de l'être tout autant avec nous.

Des séminaires d'équipe, une fête d'été annuelle et une collaboration étroite avec des collègues de différents pays font partie de l'aventure et élargissent ton réseau personnel et professionnel. Mais l'essentiel est simple : nous voulons progresser chaque jour et nous cherchons des personnes qui le veulent aussi. Ici, tu assumes un rôle qui compte, dans un environnement international, et tu contribues activement à façonner l'avenir du coliving en Europe.

Rejoins Room Estate et construis avec nous l'avenir du logement. 🚀

jobs.title: Applied AI Engineer
jobs.description:
Applied AI Engineer

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Applied AI Engineer based in Netherlands.

As an Applied AI Engineer, you will play a pivotal role in designing and building the next generation of intelligent, agentic systems.
You will develop the core infrastructure that enables AI agents to manage context, use tools, coordinate tasks, and continuously improve their performance.
Working at the intersection of advanced AI research and practical software engineering, you will transform complex operational workflows into reliable, scalable production solutions.
You will establish robust evaluation, testing, and observability frameworks to ensure AI-powered systems deliver predictable and measurable results.
You will also explore innovative ways to integrate coding agents and specialized subagents into software development processes.
Collaborating closely with product and operational teams, you will identify high-impact automation opportunities and translate them into effective technical solutions.
As an early core member of the engineering team, you will have significant influence over architectural decisions, technical standards, and the long-term AI strategy.


Accountabilities

In this role, you will design and implement the technical foundations of agentic systems while driving the adoption of AI-powered engineering workflows. Your responsibilities will include:

  • Design and build essential components of agentic systems, including memory, context management, tool-calling capabilities, orchestration mechanisms, and feedback loops.

  • Develop reusable AI infrastructure that enables new workflows to be introduced quickly, consistently, and with predictable reliability.

  • Build comprehensive evaluation frameworks to measure agent performance, identify failure points, and understand the factors behind successful outcomes.

  • Integrate testing, tracing, debugging, and evaluation into the software engineering lifecycle as fundamental practices.

  • Develop systems and validation processes that allow agentic workflows to be thoroughly assessed before production deployment.

  • Advance the use of large language models (LLMs) in software development by creating sophisticated AI-assisted engineering workflows.

  • Build workflows where coding agents and specialized subagents can explore code repositories, implement changes, review architecture, validate conventions, run evaluations, and iterate with minimal human intervention.

  • Actively use agentic engineering tools and workflows in daily development activities.

  • Design architectures that enable specialized AI agents, tools, deterministic software, and human expertise to work together effectively.

  • Determine when to use LLMs, traditional software solutions, human intervention, or coordinated multi-agent approaches to achieve the best outcomes.

  • Collaborate with operational and product teams to understand existing processes, identify high-value automation opportunities, and transform them into reliable production systems.

  • Establish scalable architectural patterns and engineering standards for agentic systems as the organization grows.

  • Take ownership of technical decisions and contribute to the overall direction of the AI engineering function.

    • Requirements

    The ideal candidate is a strong software engineer with hands-on experience building production-ready AI systems and the autonomy to solve complex technical challenges in a rapidly evolving environment. The following qualifications and skills are expected:

    • Strong software engineering background, with proven experience independently delivering complex systems from initial concept through production deployment.

    • Practical experience building and deploying AI or agentic systems that have operated in production environments.

    • Demonstrated understanding of real-world AI engineering challenges, including reliability, latency, context management, failure modes, evaluation, and observability.

    • Strong knowledge of agent architectures, tool use, structured outputs, context management, orchestration, evaluation frameworks, and feedback loops.

    • Advanced practical experience with modern LLMs and the ability to build reliable workflows around probabilistic AI systems.

    • Hands-on experience using coding agents and agentic development workflows as part of everyday software engineering.

    • Ability to break down complex engineering tasks across multiple agents or specialized subagents and implement mechanisms for validating and improving their outputs.

    • Strong architectural judgment and the ability to select the right combination of AI models, deterministic software, and human intervention for different challenges.

    • Experience with TypeScript and Node.js, or strong experience developing AI systems in Python combined with the willingness and ability to work in a TypeScript-first environment.

    • High level of autonomy, ownership, and confidence making technical decisions in ambiguous situations.

    • Strong product mindset and the ability to connect engineering decisions with operational efficiency and business outcomes.

    • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with fluency in English.

    • Startup mentality, including resilience, adaptability, initiative, and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment.

      • Benefits

      • Competitive Compensation: Annual salary ranging from €100,000 to €150,000.

      • Remote Work: Opportunity to work remotely within Europe or the United Kingdom.

      • Early-Team Influence: Join as an early core engineering team member with significant ownership over technical direction and architectural decisions.

      • Technical Autonomy: Shape engineering standards, development practices, tooling, and the foundations of the organization's agentic AI infrastructure.

      • Cutting-Edge Technology: Work extensively with advanced LLMs, autonomous agents, multi-agent architectures, and AI-powered software development workflows.

      • Meaningful Impact: Build production systems that address real operational challenges and deliver measurable business value.

      • Cross-functional Collaboration: Work closely with product and operational teams to identify opportunities and develop practical automation solutions.

After that, you'll take ownership of our website and landing pages, shaping the direction together with me while owning the design and execution, and you'll make sure our brand shows up consistently wherever people come across us, from a launch campaign to an ebook.

Beyond the design itself, I'm looking for someone who takes real ownership: someone who asks the right questions before jumping into a brief, spots what could be better and isn't afraid to challenge the obvious solution. We also use AI a lot at FeedbackFruits, and I'd love you to bring that same mindset to design, building templates and systems that help the whole team create on-brand work without starting from scratch every time. We’re building a team that moves quickly, takes ownership, and wants to make a meaningful impact on how the world’s largest organizations work. Come help us build what’s next for enterprise service management.

About the team

The Agent Deployment team is a customer-facing technical team, central to how Serval turns product capability into real business outcomes. The org is a family of roles: Deployment Strategists are the primary technical relationship and AI advisor for each customer, partnering with Deployed Software Engineers to build enterprise-grade features and products. Deployment Success Managers own each customer's long-term success, building the systems and motions that scale adoption, expansion, and renewal well past go-live.


Role Overview

As a Deployment Strategist on Serval's Agent Deployment team, you’ll be the primary technical relationship for Serval’s customers: guiding their deployments, advising their AI strategy, and owning their outcomes. You’ll work deeply within Serval’s existing product surface area: building novel workflows, configuring integrations, and shipping bug fixes and product changes yourself.

This role is for someone who thrives on execution velocity, moving quickly across multiple engagements at once. You’re at home in ambiguity and bring a strong blend of technical depth, product sense, and customer obsession. And because you sit closest to how customers actually use Serval, you'll directly shape our product roadmap: the workflows and features you build in the field make their way into the core product.

What You’ll Do

  • Own customer engagements from pilot through production launch: design and deliver deployments that fit each customer's workflows and scale adoption of Serval.

  • Build AI agents: design and build AI agents on Serval's platform that drive real value for customers.

  • Advise AI strategy: embed with customers to guide and shape how they adopt and scale AI.

  • Lead migrations: design and execute migration plans that minimize disruption and ensure seamless adoption of Serval's platform.

jobs.title: Research Staff, Voice AI Foundations [UK - Remote]
jobs.description:
Research Staff, Voice AI Foundations [UK - Remote]

Company Overview

Deepgram is the leading platform underpinning the emerging trillion-dollar Voice AI economy, providing real-time APIs for speech-to-text (STT), text-to-speech (TTS), and building production-grade voice agents at scale. More than 200,000 developers and 1,300+ organizations build voice offerings that are ‘Powered by Deepgram’, including Twilio, Cloudflare, Sierra, Decagon, Vapi, Daily, Cresta, Granola, and Jack in the Box. Deepgram’s voice-native foundation models are accessed through cloud APIs or as self-hosted and on-premises software, with unmatched accuracy, low latency, and cost efficiency. Backed by a recent Series C led by leading global investors and strategic partners, Deepgram has processed over 50,000 years of audio and transcribed more than 1 trillion words. There is no organization in the world that understands voice better than Deepgram.

Company Operating Rhythm

At Deepgram, we expect an AI-first mindset—AI use and comfort aren’t optional, they’re core to how we operate, innovate, and measure performance.

Every team member who works at Deepgram is expected to actively use and experiment with advanced AI tools, and even build your own into your everyday work. We measure how effectively AI is applied to deliver results, and consistent, creative use of the latest AI capabilities is key to success here. Candidates should be comfortable adopting new models and modes quickly, integrating AI into their workflows, and continuously pushing the boundaries of what these technologies can do.

Additionally, we move at the pace of AI. Change is rapid, and you can expect your day-to-day work to evolve just as quickly. This may not be the right role if you’re not excited to experiment, adapt, think on your feet, and learn constantly, or if you’re seeking something highly prescriptive with a traditional 9-to-5.

The Opportunity

Voice is the most natural modality for human interaction with machines. However, current sequence modeling paradigms based on jointly scaling model and data cannot deliver voice AI capable of universal human interaction. The challenges are rooted in fundamental data problems posed by audio: real-world audio data is scarce and enormously diverse, spanning a vast space of voices, speaking styles, and acoustic conditions. Even if billions of hours of audio were accessible, its inherent high dimensionality creates computational and storage costs that make training and deployment prohibitively expensive at world scale. We believe that entirely new paradigms for audio AI are needed to overcome these challenges and make voice interaction accessible to everyone.


The Role

As a Member of the Research Staff, you will pioneer the development of Latent Space Models (LSMs), a new approach that aims to solve the fundamental data, scale, and cost challenges associated with building robust, contextualized voice AI. Your research will focus on solving one or more of the following problems:

  • Build next-generation neural audio codecs that achieve extreme, low bit-rate compression and high fidelity reconstruction across a world-scale corpus of general audio.

  • Pioneer steerable generative models that can synthesize the full diversity of human speech from the codec latent representation, from casual conversation to highly emotional expression to complex multi-speaker scenarios with environmental noise and overlapping speech.

  • Develop embedding systems that cleanly factorize the codec latent space into interpretable dimensions of speaker, content, style, environment, and channel effects -- enabling precise control over each aspect and the ability to massively amplify an existing seed dataset through “latent recombination”.

  • Leverage latent recombination to generate synthetic audio data at previously impossible scales, unlocking joint model and data scaling paradigms for audio.  Endeavor to train multimodal speech-to-speech systems that can 1) understand any human irrespective of their demographics, state, or environment and 2) produce empathic, human-like responses that achieve conversational or task-oriented objectives.   

  • Design model architectures, training schemes, and inference algorithms that are adapted for hardware at the bare metal enabling cost efficient training on billion-hour datasets and powering real-time inference for hundreds of millions of concurrent conversations.

The Challenge

We are seeking researchers who:

  • See "unsolved" problems as opportunities to pioneer entirely new approaches

  • Can identify the one critical experiment that will validate or kill an idea in days, not months

  • Have the vision to scale successful proofs-of-concept 100x

  • Are obsessed with using AI to automate and amplify your own impact

If you find yourself energized rather than daunted by these expectations—if you're already thinking about five ideas to try while reading this—you might be the researcher we need. This role demands obsession with the problems, creativity in approach, and relentless drive toward elegant, scalable solutions. The technical challenges are immense, but the potential impact is transformative.


It's Important to Us That You Have

  • Strong mathematical foundation in statistical learning theory, particularly in areas relevant to self-supervised and multimodal learning

  • Deep expertise in foundation model architectures, with an understanding of how to scale training across multiple modalities

  • Proven ability to bridge theory and practice—someone who can both derive novel mathematical formulations and implement them efficiently

  • Demonstrated ability to build data pipelines that can process and curate massive datasets while maintaining quality and diversity

  • Track record of designing controlled experiments that isolate the impact of architectural innovations and validate theoretical insights

  • Experience optimizing models for real-world deployment, including knowledge of hardware constraints and efficiency techniques

  • History of open-source contributions or research publications that have advanced the state of the art in speech/language AI


Ideal Researcher Profile

An ideal researcher, as evidenced by the recurring themes across these foundational papers, excels in five key areas: (1) Statistical & Mathematical Foundations, (2) Algorithmic Innovation & Implementation, (3) Data-Driven & Scalable Systems, (4) Hardware & Systems Understanding, and (5) Rigorous Experimental Design. Below is a synthesis of how each paper highlights these qualities, with references illustrating why they matter for building robust, impactful deep learning models.



1. Statistical & Mathematical Foundations

Mastery of Core Concepts

Many papers, like Scaling Laws for Neural Language Models and Neural Discrete Representation Learning (VQ-VAE), reflect the importance of power-law analyses, derivation of novel losses, or adaptation of fundamental equations (e.g., in VQ-VAE's commitment loss or rectified flows in Scaling Rectified Flow Transformers). Such mathematical grounding clarifies why models converge or suffer collapse.

Combining Existing Theories in Novel Ways

Papers such as Moshi (combining text modeling, audio codecs, and hierarchical generative modeling) and Finite Scalar Quantization (FSQ's adaptation of classic scalar quantization to replace vector-quantized representations) show how reusing but reimagining known techniques can yield breakthroughs. Many references (e.g., the structured state-space duality in Transformers are SSMs) underscore how unifying previously separate research lines can reveal powerful algorithmic or theoretical insights.

Logical Reasoning and Assumption Testing

Across all papers—particularly in the problem statements of Whisper or Rectified Flow Transformers—the authors present assumptions (e.g., "scaling data leads to zero-shot robustness" or "straight-line noise injection improves sample efficiency") and systematically verify them with thorough empirical results. An ideal researcher similarly grounds new ideas in well-formed, testable hypotheses.


2. Algorithmic Innovation & Implementation

Creative Solutions to Known Bottlenecks

Each paper puts forth a unique algorithmic contribution—Rectified Flow Transformers redefines standard diffusion paths, FSQ proposes simpler scalar quantizations contrasted with VQ, phi-3 mini relies on curated data and blocksparse attention, and Mamba-2 merges SSM speed with attention concepts.

Turning Theory into Practice

Whether it's the direct preference optimization (DPO) for alignment in phi-3 or the residual vector quantization in SoundStream, these works show that bridging design insights with implementable prototypes is essential.

Clear Impact Through Prototypes & Open-Source

Many references (Whisper, neural discrete representation learning, Mamba-2) highlight releasing code or pretrained models, enabling the broader community to replicate and build upon new methods. This premise of collaboration fosters faster progress.


3. Data-Driven & Scalable Systems

Emphasis on Large-Scale Data and Efficient Pipelines

Papers such as Robust Speech Recognition via Large-Scale Weak Supervision (Whisper) and BASE TTS demonstrate that collecting and processing hundreds of thousands of hours of real-world audio can unlock new capabilities in zero-shot or low-resource domains. Meanwhile, phi-3 Technical Report shows that filtering and curating data at scale (e.g., "data optimal regime") can yield high performance even in smaller models.

Strategic Use of Data for Staged Training

A recurring strategy is to vary sources of data or the order of tasks. Whisper trains on multilingual tasks, BASE TTS uses subsets/stages for pretraining on speech tokens, and phi-3 deploys multiple training phases (web data, then synthetic data). This systematic approach to data underscores how an ideal researcher designs training curricula and data filtering protocols for maximum performance.


4. Hardware & Systems Understanding

Efficient Implementations at Scale

Many works illustrate how researchers tune architectures for modern accelerators: the In-Datacenter TPU paper exemplifies domain-specific hardware design for dense matrix multiplications, while phi-3 leverages blocksparse attention and custom Triton kernels to run advanced LLMs on resource-limited devices.

Real-Time & On-Device Constraints

SoundStream shows how to compress audio in real time on a smartphone CPU, demonstrating that knowledge of hardware constraints (latency, limited memory) drives design choices. Similarly, Moshi's low-latency streaming TTS and phi-3-mini's phone-based inference highlight that an ideal researcher must adapt algorithms to resource limits while maintaining robustness.

Architectural & Optimization Details

Papers like Mamba-2 in Transformers are SSMs and the In-Datacenter TPU work show how exploiting specialized matrix decomposition, custom memory hierarchies, or quantization approaches can lead to breakthroughs in speed or energy efficiency.


5. Rigorous Experimental Design

Controlled Comparisons & Ablations

Nearly all papers—Whisper, FSQ, Mamba-2, BASE TTS—use systematic ablations to isolate the impact of individual components (e.g., ablation on vector-quantization vs. scalar quantization in FSQ, or size of codebooks in VQ-VAEs). This approach reveals which design decisions truly matter.

Multifold Evaluation Metrics

From MUSHRA listening tests (SoundStream, BASE TTS) to FID in image synthesis (Scaling Rectified Flow Transformers, FSQ) to perplexity or zero-shot generalization in language (phi-3, Scaling Laws for Neural Language Models), the works demonstrate the value of comprehensive, carefully chosen metrics.

Stress Tests & Edge Cases

Whisper's out-of-distribution speech benchmarks, SoundStream's evaluation on speech + music, or Mamba-2's performance on multi-query associative recall demonstrate the importance of specialized challenge sets. Researchers who craft or adopt rigorous benchmarks and "red-team" their models (as in phi-3 safety alignment) are better prepared to address real-world complexities.



Summary

Overall, an ideal researcher in deep learning consistently demonstrates:

  • A solid grounding in theoretical and statistical principles

  • A talent for proposing and validating new algorithmic solutions

  • The capacity to orchestrate data pipelines that scale and reflect real-world diversity

  • Awareness of hardware constraints and system-level trade-offs for efficiency

  • Thorough and transparent experimental practices

These qualities surface across research on speech (Whisper, BASE TTS), language modeling (Scaling Laws, phi-3), specialized hardware (TPU, Transformers are SSMs), and new representation methods (VQ-VAE, FSQ, SoundStream). By balancing these attributes—rigorous math, innovative algorithms, large-scale data engineering, hardware-savvy optimizations, and reproducible experimentation—researchers can produce impactful, trustworthy advancements in foundational deep learning.




Foundational Papers

This job description was generated through analysis of the following papers:

  • Robust Speech Recognition via Large-Scale Weak Supervision (arXiv:2212.04356)

  • Moshi: a speech-text foundation model for real-time dialogue (arXiv:2410.00037)

  • Scaling Rectified Flow Transformers for High-Resolution Image Synthesis (arXiv:2403.03206)

  • Scaling Laws for Neural Language Models (arXiv:2001.08361)

  • BASE TTS: Lessons from building a billion-parameter Text-to-Speech model on 100K hours of data (arXiv:2402.08093)

  • In-Datacenter Performance Analysis of a Tensor Processing Unit (arXiv:1704.04760)

  • Neural Discrete Representation Learning (arXiv:1711.00937)

  • SoundStream: An End-to-End Neural Audio Codec (arXiv:2107.03312)

  • Finite Scalar Quantization: VQ-VAE Made Simple (arXiv:2309.15505)

  • Phi-3 Technical Report: A Highly Capable Language Model Locally on Your Phone (arXiv:2404.14219)

  • Transformers are SSMs: Generalized Models and Efficient Algorithms Through Structured State Space Duality (arXiv:2405.21060)

jobs.title: Privacy & AI Officer
jobs.description:
Privacy & AI Officer

Wil jij bijdragen aan een organisatie die in control is op het gebied van privacy en verantwoorde inzet van AI? En weet jij wet- en regelgeving te vertalen naar duidelijke processen en praktisch advies? Als Privacy & AI Officer help je afdelingen zorgvuldig om te gaan met persoonsgegevens en AI-risico’s tijdig te herkennen. Je adviseert, coördineert, bewaakt en rapporteert. Zo maak jij het verschil voor onze leden, collega’s en de continuïteit van Univé Zuid-Nederland!

Wie ben jij?

Je bent een toegankelijke professional met een passie voor privacybescherming en verantwoorde AI-governance. Je hebt een scherp oog voor risico’s en verbindt beleid, processen en praktijk op een natuurlijke manier. Met jouw analytisch vermogen en zorgvuldige oordeelsvorming help je de organisatie risico’s tijdig te herkennen en beheersen. Je schakelt makkelijk met collega’s, management en andere belanghebbenden en maakt complexe onderwerpen helder en praktisch.

 

Daarnaast breng je mee:

  • Hbo+ werk- en denkniveau, bij voorkeur in een juridische richting.

  • Diepgaande kennis van de AVG, privacywetgeving en relevante wet- en regelgeving.

  • Praktische kennis van de AVG en ervaring met bijvoorbeeld DPIA’s, datalekken of privacyprocessen.

  • Kennis van en interesse in AI-governance, AI-beleid, de AI Act en het beheersen van AI-risico’s.

  • Ervaring met het implementeren en bewaken van beleid, regelingen en processen.

  • Sterk analytisch vermogen, zorgvuldige oordeelsvorming en resultaatgerichtheid.

  • Goede communicatieve vaardigheden en het vermogen om belanghebbenden mee te nemen.

 

Wat ga je doen

Als Privacy en AI Officer ondersteun je afdelingen bij het naleven van de AVG, het Univé privacybeleid en het AI-beleid. Maar pak je ook (pro-)actief zelf activiteiten op in het kader van dit aandachtsgebied. Je hebt een spilfunctie in het vroegtijdig onderkennen en beheersen van privacy- en AI-risico’s. Je adviseert je collega’s in de eerste lijn, coördineert de implementatie van beleid en zorgt voor het onderhoud en de naleving van privacy-instrumenten en processen.

 

Daarnaast registreer, coördineer en beheer je AI-toepassingen, AI-risico’s en relevante beheersmaatregelen. Je helpt bij AI-use cases, naleving van wet- en regelgeving en verantwoord gebruik en rapporteert hierover. Ook speel je een actieve rol in beleidsontwikkeling en advisering. Je volgt wijzigingen in wet- en regelgeving en vertaalt deze naar de praktijk. Zo help je Univé Zuid-Nederland om aantoonbaar in control te blijven. Het zwaartepunt van de functie ligt bij privacy, waarmee jij vanuit de eerste lijn waarde toevoegt in dit domein. AI speelt daarin een aanvullende rol en er is ruimte om je hierin verder te ontwikkelen, net als de organisatie dat doet. Je adviseert niet alleen: je helpt ook zelf bij de uitvoering waarbij je samenwerkt met de eerste lijn business owners. Juist die combinatie maakt deze functie afwisselend en zichtbaar waardevol voor de organisatie.

 

Hieronder een greep uit jouw werkzaamheden:

  • Je helpt afdelingen bij privacy, AVG, AI-beleid en relevante wet- en regelgeving.

  • Je coördineert de implementatie, naleving en doorontwikkeling van beleid en processen.

  • Je registreert, coördineert Privacy- en AI-risico’s en zorgt voor opvolging en borging van de (beheers)maatregelen.           

  • Je signaleert risico’s, ontwikkelingen en verbeterkansen en vertaalt deze naar duidelijke acties.

  • Je werkt nauw samen met de 2e lijn Risk & Compliance

 

Wat wij bieden

Een veelzijdige functie van 32 uur per week met directe lijnen naar de bestuurder, ruimte voor eigen initiatief en mogelijkheden om je professioneel te ontwikkelen. Je werkt aan onderwerpen die ertoe doen voor onze leden en collega’s, binnen een coöperatieve organisatie waarin samenwerken en verantwoordelijkheid nemen centraal staan. Daarbovenop kun je rekenen op:

  • Een brutosalaris tussen de € 3.859 en € 5.358 per maand, exclusief vakantiegeld, afhankelijk van jouw ervaring.

  • Een contract van 1 jaar met de intentie voor een vaste aanstelling.

  • Een 13e maand, bedrijfsfitnessregeling, fietsregeling en een goede pensioenregeling.

  • 25 vakantiedagen en 13 compensatie dagen bij een fulltime dienstverband.

  • Een zelfstandige en verantwoordelijke functie binnen een betrouwbare organisatie.

  • Uitstekende werksfeer; plezier in je werk staat bij ons voorop.

  • Aantrekkelijke kortingen op onze verzekeringsproducten en diensten.

 

Wie wij zijn

Univé Zuid-Nederland is één van de acht regionale Univé’s, een coöperatie met de missie om de meest menselijke financiële dienstverlener van Nederland te zijn. Ons werkgebied bestaat uit Noord-Brabant, Limburg, Zeeland en delen van Utrecht, Gelderland en Zuid-Holland. Wij zijn verzekeraar en bemiddelaar in schade- en levensverzekeringen, voor zowel de particuliere als zakelijke markt. Daarnaast zijn wij ook erkend hypotheekadviseur. Onze belofte, persoonlijk en dichtbij, komt tot leven in onze lokale dienstverlening, samenwerkingen en sponsoring. Het mooiste van Univé? Dat zijn de mensen, de geschiedenis, de cultuur en de betrokkenheid. A Great Place to Work!

Na je sollicitatie

stagiair(e) Advies & Onderzoek – Arbeidsmarkt en Strategisch HRM

0,8- 1fte per week | Utrecht | Hybride | Transformaties van organisaties| € 600,- | Wo-master

Jouw vooruitgang begint bij Berenschot

Hoe zorgen we ervoor dat mensen en organisaties klaar zijn voor de arbeidsmarkt van morgen? Hoe kunnen we talent beter benutten, ontwikkeling stimuleren en organisaties helpen om toekomstbestendig te blijven?

Bij Berenschot krijg je de kans om als stagiair mee te werken aan actuele arbeidsmarkt- en HR-vraagstukken. Je maakt kennis met het adviesvak, werkt samen met ervaren adviseurs en ontdekt hoe je wetenschappelijke inzichten vertaalt naar oplossingen die in de praktijk het verschil maken.

Je werkt op het snijvlak van arbeidsmarkt, human capital, strategisch HRM, skills, leren en ontwikkelen en organisatieverandering.

Dit ga je doen

Tijdens je stage draai je mee in verschillende advies- en onderzoeksprojecten. Je helpt bij het onderzoeken van complexe vraagstukken, het verzamelen en analyseren van informatie en het ontwikkelen van adviezen, programma's en instrumenten.

Je werkzaamheden kunnen onder andere bestaan uit:

  • Uitvoeren van literatuuronderzoek, interviews en kwalitatieve of kwantitatieve analyses.

  • Ondersteunen bij adviestrajecten voor werkgevers, overheden en brancheorganisaties.

  • Voorbereiden en uitwerken van gesprekken, workshops en werksessies.

  • Meedenken over nieuwe methodieken, instrumenten en oplossingen.

  • Ondersteuning bij het vertalen van onderzoeksresultaten naar heldere rapportages, presentaties en adviezen.

  • Bijdragen aan publicaties over actuele arbeidsmarkt- en HR-thema's.

Je kunt bijvoorbeeld werken aan vraagstukken rondom arbeidsmarktkrapte, strategische personeelsplanning, skillsgericht werken, talentontwikkeling, leren en ontwikkelen, duurzame inzetbaarheid of regionale samenwerking op de arbeidsmarkt.

Afhankelijk van je interesses en de mogelijkheden binnen onze projecten krijg je ruimte voor een eigen onderzoeks- of ontwikkelopdracht. Ook is het mogelijk om je stageperiode te combineren met het schrijven van je scriptie.

Hier kom je terecht

Berenschot is een zelfstandig en onafhankelijk Nederlands organisatieadviesbureau in Utrecht, waar we met meer dan 500 gedreven collega’s werken aan duurzame oplossingen voor de vraagstukken van onze opdrachtgevers. We dragen bij aan vooruitgang in organisaties en de maatschappij met onze adviezen en oplossingen. Onze organisatie heeft een platte structuur zonder partners, waardoor je invloed hebt op de projecten die je uitvoert. 

Dit zijn je directe collega’s

Je komt terecht in de adviesgroep Transformaties van Organisaties, waar we organisaties helpen bij complexe verander- en ontwikkelvraagstukken. We werken op het snijvlak van strategie, organisatie-inrichting, leiderschap, cultuur en mensontwikkeling. Daarbinnen maak je onderdeel uit van het Arbeidsmarkt & Mensen. Samen werken we aan vraagstukken rondom HR-transformaties, goed werkgeverschap, arbeidsmarkt, talentontwikkeling en de toekomst van werk. Wat ons verbindt, is de overtuiging dat organisaties pas echt succesvol kunnen zijn wanneer mensen kunnen groeien, samenwerken en het beste uit zichzelf halen. Vanuit die overtuiging combineren we inhoudelijke expertise met een resultaatgerichte en praktische aanpak, waarbij kennisdeling, samenwerking en persoonlijke ontwikkeling centraal staan.


Dit neem je mee

Je bent een nieuwsgierige WO-masterstudent met interesse in arbeidsmarkt-, organisatie- en HR-vraagstukken. Je vindt het leuk om maatschappelijke thema's te onderzoeken en wilt ontdekken hoe het adviesvak in de praktijk werkt.

Daarnaast:

  • je volgt een universitaire masteropleiding, bijvoorbeeld in de richting van bestuurskunde, organisatiekunde, psychologie, sociologie, HRM, Strategic HRM, Business Administration (Management Consulting), economie, onderwijskunde of een vergelijkbare studie.

  • je bent analytisch sterk en weet informatie kritisch te beoordelen, waarbij je ook effectief gebruikmaakt van hulpmiddelen zoals AI.

  • je neemt initiatief, werkt zelfstandig en pakt nieuwe vraagstukken met enthousiasme op.

  • je communiceert helder, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk.

  • Je bent gedurende je stage ingeschreven bij een onderwijsinstelling

Dit bieden we jou

Bij Berenschot bieden we een unieke werkomgeving zonder aandeelhouders of partners, wat ons de vrijheid geeft om te ondernemen en ons in te zetten voor maatschappelijke thema’s. We hebben een informele cultuur, korte communicatielijnen en volop kansen voor persoonlijke en professionele groei. Daarnaast bieden we:

  • Een stagevergoeding van € 600,- bruto per maand op basis van fulltime.

  • flexibele werkmogelijkheden, ook thuis

  • begeleiding door twee adviseurs op het gebied van strategie en operations

  • een stimulerende en leerzame werkomgeving waarin ruimte is voor eigen inbreng

  • de mogelijkheid om een netwerk op te bouwen binnen Berenschot en met bedrijven

  • Een laptop.

  • Veel stagiairs zijn na hun stage aan een traineeship bij Berenschot begonnen – bij goed presteren biedt deze stage uitstekende kansen voor jouw carrière.

Stageplusprogramma

Naast je stage kun je deelnemen aan het Stageplusprogramma van Berenschot: een opleidingsprogramma van circa 3,5 maand dat trainingen biedt op het gebied van advieskennis, -vaardigheden en persoonlijke ontwikkeling. Dit vraagt gemiddeld één dagdeel per twee weken. Via deze link lees je meer over het programma . Alles over ons stageplusprogramma | Berenschot

Solliciteer meteen

Spreekt deze stage je aan? Wacht niet langer en solliciteer! Neem contact op met Oumnia Makrani via WhatsApp (06 13 33 87 70) of per e-mail () voor informatie over de procedure. Oumnia is op vrijdag bereikbaar. Heb je een dringende vraag? Mail dan naar .

Vergeet in je motivatie niet te vermelden voor welke periode je een stage zoekt en hoeveel uur per week je beschikbaar bent. Dan kunnen we je sollicitatie zo goed mogelijk beoordelen.

Zo ziet het sollicitatieproces eruit

Heb je gesolliciteerd? Dan ontvang je binnen één werkweek een reactie. Is die positief? Dan nodigen we je graag uit voor een kennismaking. Zijn we na dit gesprek allebei enthousiast? Dan volgt een gesprek met collega-adviseurs en je toekomstige manager. Dat is het moment om jouw laatste vragen te stellen. Blijkt daaruit dat jij een echte Berenschotter bent? Dan gaan we snel over tot een concreet aanbod. Hierna ben je een echte Berenschotter en heten we je graag welkom in ons team.

Sales Development Representative (SDR)

About DeleteMe:

DeleteMe is the leader in proactive privacy protection. We help security teams reduce their human attack surface by continuously monitoring and removing exposed personal data (PII) from the open web — the very data threat actors use to launch social engineering, phishing, Gen-AI deepfake, doxxing campaigns, physical threats, and identity fraud.

Operating as a fast-growing, global SaaS company, DeleteMe serves both consumers and enterprises. DeleteMe has completed over 100 million opt-out removals, helping customers reduce risks associated with identity theft, spam, doxxing, and other cybersecurity threats. We deliver detailed privacy reports, continuous monitoring, and expert support to ensure ongoing protection.

DeleteMe acts as a scalable, managed defense layer for your most vulnerable attack vector: your people. That’s why 30% of the Fortune 100, top tech firms, major banks, federal agencies, and U.S. states rely on DeleteMe to protect their workforce.

DeleteMe is led by a passionate and experienced team and driven by a powerful mission to empower consumers with privacy.

Job Summary:

We’re looking for a motivated, driven SDR who wants to build a career in sales or marketing at a growing startup. You’ll be the first point of contact for many of our prospects, turning outbound outreach, event follow-ups, and inbound interest into qualified opportunities for our Account Executives. You’ll work closely with both the sales and marketing teams, so you’ll see how a go-to-market engine runs from the inside.

This is a high-activity role. You will be responsible for a high volume of coordinated calls and emails for both inbound and outbound leads. The role also entails account research into target accounts as well as learning to interpret and respond to market signals in a timely fashion.

Job Responsibilities:

  • Develop AI-driven nurture & outbound campaigns to target accounts

  • Follow up on leads from trade shows, webinars, and other events

  • Qualify inbound leads and route them to Account Executives

  • Create and manage opportunities for Account Executives

  • Keep accurate records in our CRM

  • Partner with marketing on campaigns, messaging, and feedback from the field
