Job Requirements:

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills

  • Competitive, Persistence, Resilience, and comfort with rejection

  • Coachability and a strong drive to improve

  • Organized, self-directed work habits

  • This role requires domestic and international travel. All standard travel expenses will be covered in accordance with the company's travel reimbursement policy.

Growth:

jobs.description:
Partner Sales Manager (w/m/d)

Unser Ziel ist eine Solaranlage auf jedem Dach, ein Speicher in jedem Haus und ein E-Auto in jeder Garage. Enpal macht das möglich mit einer integrierten Gesamtlösung für dezentrale Energie – von Solaranlage und Batteriespeicher über Wallbox, Smart Meter bis zur Wärmepumpe. Herzstück ist unsere KI-gestützte Plattform Enpal.One+, die tausende Systeme intelligent vernetzt und Strombezug sowie -einspeisung effizient am Energiemarkt optimiert.

Bist Du bereit für Lösungen, die mehr als nur ein Versprechen sind und täglich echte Lebensqualität in tausende Haushalte bringen? Was du bei Enpal gestaltest, liefert morgen sauberen Strom und verändert nachhaltig, wie wir Energie nutzen.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du übernimmst das Onboarding neuer Vertriebspartner sowie ihrer Vertriebler und begleitest sie vom ersten Kontakt bis hin zum erfolgreichen Vertragsabschluss.

  • Du betreust bestehende Vertriebspartner ganzheitlich, unterstützt sie durch fachliche und vertriebliche Impulse und trägst so entscheidend zu ihrem kontinuierlichen Erfolg bei.

  • Du führst regelmäßig Schulungen für neue und bestehende Vertriebspartner sowie deren Vertriebler durch und sorgst so für eine stetige Verbesserung ihres Fachwissens und ihrer Verkaufsfertigkeiten.

  • Du übernimmst eigenverantwortlich die Planung, Organisation und Durchführung von vertrieblichen Veranstaltungen im Bereich PV und erneuerbare Energien, um Vertriebspartner bei der Erweiterung ihres Portfolios zu unterstützen.

  • Du begleitest bei Bedarf unsere Vertriebspartner zu Kundenterminen vor Ort, um den Verkaufsprozess aktiv zu fördern und den direkten Austausch zu stärken.

  • Du leistest hierbei aktive Unterstützung bei der Umsetzung von Vertragsabschlüssen und trägst so direkt zum gemeinsamen Geschäftserfolg bei.

  • Du pflegst ein professionelles Relationship Management zu lokalen Führungskräften der Vertriebspartner und repräsentierst unser Unternehmen in allen Interaktionen souverän und überzeugend.

Dein Profil

  • Du verfügst über mehrjährige Vertriebserfahrung. Du bist aber auch offen, dich in neue Themen wie PV-Vertrieb einzuarbeiten. Erfahrung in einem großen Finanzvertrieb ist ein Plus.

  • Du bringst eine ausgeprägte Eigenmotivation sowie hohe Resilienz mit und bewältigst auch anspruchsvolle Situationen zielorientiert und erfolgreich.

  • Du bist ein leidenschaftlicher Coach, der Freude daran hat, Menschen zu entwickeln und ihnen dabei zu helfen, stetig besser zu werden.

  • Du zeichnest dich durch einen starken Erfolgswillen aus, hast ein Auge für Details und bist stets ergebnisorientiert.

  • Du bist es gewohnt, viel unterwegs zu sein, und schätzt den direkten Austausch mit Vertriebspartnern sowie Kunden vor Ort.

  • Du beherrschst die deutsche Sprache fließend in Wort und Schrift, weitere Sprachkenntnisse wie Türkisch, Russisch, Polnisch oder Rumänisch sind von Vorteil.

Du bist interessiert, auch wenn du nicht alle Anforderungen erfüllst? Bewirb dich trotzdem! Wir freuen uns darauf, dein Potenzial zu entdecken - unabhängig davon, ob deine Erfahrung jede einzelne Voraussetzung erfüllt. ☀️


Darauf kannst Du Dich freuen

  • Arbeite in Deutschlands erstem grünen Unicorn - Gestalte aktiv die solare Energiewende mit.

  • Die Sonne scheint auf der ganzen Welt - Bei Enpal arbeitest du mit einem hochmotivierten, diversen Team aus über 65 Nationalitäten.

  • Dein Kick-start bei Enpal - Onboarding-Tag mit Welcome Bag, Buddy-Programm und einem Team, das dich wirklich abholt.

  • Bleib auf dem Laufenden & gestalte mit - Transparente All-Hands, kurze Entscheidungswege und eine offene Feedback-Kultur, denn ohne Fehler gibt es keinen Fortschritt.

  • Energiewende geht nur gemeinsam - Bei Enpal erwartet dich ein legendärer Teamspirit und unvergessliche Team- und Companyevents.

  • Dein Extra-Boost - 29 + 1 Urlaubstag, vergünstigte Mitgliedschaft bei Wellhub und Corporate Benefits. Alles, was dir hilft, Arbeit und Leben gut zu verbinden.

  • Vorsorge für deine Zukunft – Wir denken nicht nur nachhaltig, wenn es um Energie geht, sondern auch, wenn es um dich geht. Nutze unsere betriebliche Altersvorsorge und baue dir Schritt für Schritt ein solides Fundament für deine Zukunft auf.

jobs.title: Senior Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
Senior Customer Success Manager

Über HeyVera

Unsere KI-Assistentin Vera übernimmt die Telefonie für Hausverwaltungen: Sie nimmt Anliegen auf, erkennt Notfälle und spielt alles direkt in die Verwaltersoftware ein. Über 250 Hausverwaltungen setzen bereits auf HeyVera, und wir wachsen schnell. Unser Ziel: Customer Success, der mit KI und Automatisierung skaliert, nicht mit immer mehr Köpfen.

Deine Mission

Du sorgst dafür, dass unsere Kunden mit HeyVera erfolgreich starten, Vera langfristig optimal nutzen und mit uns wachsen. Du bist technische Ansprechperson, Beraterin oder Berater und Vertriebspersönlichkeit in einer Person. Perspektivisch übernimmst du die Leitung unseres Customer-Success- und Support-Bereichs.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du verantwortest Onboarding und Betreuung unserer Kunden, vom Start bis zum produktiven, langfristigen Einsatz.

  • Du richtest Schnittstellen zu Verwaltersoftware mit ein, analysierst technische Fragen selbst und koordinierst Lösungen mit unserer Entwicklung.

  • Du erkennst Upsell-Potenziale (Integrationen, Lizenzen, Tarife) und führst die Gespräche dazu eigenständig, mit messbaren Wachstumszielen.

  • Du baust mit Tools wie n8n, Make, ChatGPT oder Claude automatisierte Workflows für Onboarding, Support, Follow-ups und Check-ins.

  • Du definierst und steuerst Kennzahlen wie Churn, Time-to-Value, Produktnutzung und Expansion-ARR.

Das bringst du mit

  • Mehrere Jahre Erfahrung in Customer Success, Account Management oder technischem Support bei einem B2B-SaaS-Unternehmen

  • Nachweisbare Vertriebserfahrung, idealerweise Upsell im Bestandskundengeschäft

  • Verständnis von APIs, Softwareintegrationen und digitalen Workflows

  • Praktische Erfahrung damit, eigene Abläufe mit KI-Tools zu automatisieren

  • Kommunikationsstärke, auch in schwierigen Kundengesprächen, und sehr gutes Deutsch

Nice to have

  • Erfahrung mit n8n, Make, Zapier, LLMs oder KI-Agenten

  • Erste Führungserfahrung oder der klare Wunsch, einen Bereich zu verantworten

  • Kenntnisse der Immobilienwirtschaft oder von Verwaltersoftware

Was dich erwartet

  • Ein KI-Produkt, das den Alltag von Hausverwaltungen heute schon spürbar verändert

  • Viel Gestaltungsfreiheit: Du baust Customer Success mit auf und entscheidest mit, wie wir KI intern einsetzen

  • Klare Perspektive zur Leitung des Customer-Success-Bereichs

  • Direkte Wege zu Geschäftsführung, Vertrieb und Entwicklung

  • Aktienoptionen, Firmenlaptop, regelmäßige Teamevents und Homeoffice nach Absprache

  • Wettbewerbsfähiges Fixgehalt plus leistungsabhängige variable Vergütung

Deine Bewerbung

Ein Anschreiben brauchen wir nicht. Viel wichtiger sind uns deine Antworten auf die Fragen im Bewerbungsformular, vor allem ein konkretes Beispiel, wie du schon selbst etwas mit KI oder Automatisierung gelöst hast.

jobs.title: Projektkoordinator Operations & Steuerung (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Projektkoordinator Operations & Steuerung (m/w/d)

Über Uns

Die Harms Holding vereint mehrere mittelständische Unternehmen aus unterschiedlichen Branchen in der Weser-Ems-Region. Unsere Geschäftsfelder reichen vom Handel über den Garten- und Landschaftsbau bis hin zu Gebäudedienstleistungen und der Betreuung von Außenanlagen.

Was uns verbindet? Unternehmerisches Denken, kurze Entscheidungswege und der Anspruch, Dinge pragmatisch und effizient umzusetzen.

Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams in Oldenburg suchen wir eine strukturierte und engagierte Persönlichkeit, die gerne Verantwortung übernimmt, kaufmännische Prozesse steuert und verschiedene Projekte innerhalb unserer Unternehmensgruppe koordiniert. Die Position ist als Vollzeitstelle ausgelegt, wobei der wöchentliche Stundenumfang zwischen 32 und 40 Stunden individuell vereinbart werden kann.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Projektkoordination & Steuerung: Du organisierst, koordinierst und überwachst operative Projekte und sorgst für strukturierte Abläufe.

  • Buchhaltung & kaufmännische Verwaltung: Du unterstützt die laufende Buchhaltung unserer Gesellschaften, prüfst Geschäftsvorfälle und übernimmst deren Zuordnung und Kontierung.

  • Zusammenarbeit mit Subunternehmen: Du koordinierst externe Dienstleister und Subunternehmen, überwachst Termine und Leistungen und stellst reibungslose Abläufe sicher.

  • Unternehmensübergreifende Organisation: Du übernimmst kaufmännische und organisatorische Aufgaben für verschiedene Gesellschaften unserer Holding.

  • Prozessoptimierung: Du erkennst Verbesserungspotenziale, entwickelst bestehende Abläufe weiter und setzt eigene Ideen um.

Das bringst du mit

  • Eine abgeschlossene kaufmännische Ausbildung, ein betriebswirtschaftliches Studium oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation

  • Berufserfahrung in der kaufmännischen Verwaltung, Projektkoordination oder operativen Steuerung

  • Grundlegende Kenntnisse in der Buchhaltung und einen sicheren Umgang mit Zahlen

  • Eine strukturierte, selbstständige und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise

  • Organisationstalent und die Fähigkeit, unterschiedliche Aufgaben und Projekte gleichzeitig im Blick zu behalten

  • Kommunikationsstärke, Eigeninitiative und Verantwortungsbewusstsein

  • Sicherer Umgang mit MS Office und Offenheit für digitale Anwendungen

  • Bereitschaft zu gelegentlichen Terminen innerhalb der Weser-Ems-Region

Ihr Arbeitsumfeld

  • Abwechslungsreiche Aufgaben: Du arbeitest mit Unternehmen aus unterschiedlichen Branchen zusammen.

  • Eigenverantwortung: Du erhältst Gestaltungsspielraum und kannst eigene Ideen einbringen.

  • Kurze Entscheidungswege: Direkte Kommunikation und pragmatische Lösungen statt langer Abstimmungsprozesse.

  • Vielseitige Einblicke: Du verbindest kaufmännische Tätigkeiten mit operativer Projektsteuerung.

  • Aktive Mitgestaltung: Du entwickelst Prozesse und Strukturen innerhalb unserer Unternehmensgruppe weiter.

  • Langfristige Perspektive: Eine verantwortungsvolle Vollzeitposition in einem unternehmerisch geprägten Umfeld.

Dein Arbeitsplatz

Dein Hauptarbeitsplatz befindet sich in unserem Büro in Oldenburg. Gelegentlich bist du auch an unseren weiteren Standorten oder bei Projekten im Raum Oldenburg, Wiesmoor und Emden unterwegs.

Klingt nach deinem nächsten Karriereschritt?

Du möchtest nicht nur Aufgaben abarbeiten, sondern Verantwortung übernehmen, Dinge voranbringen und aktiv mitgestalten?

Dann freuen wir uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen!

Bewirb dich jetzt bei der Harms Holding GmbH.

Über BEAHATER

Wir sind BEAHATER, ein Streetwear-Label aus Augsburg. Mit unserem wachsenden EU-Versand stehen wir vor neuen regulatorischen Anforderungen, die wir sauber organisieren und strukturieren müssen.

Deine Aufgaben

  • EPR- und Verpackungs-Compliance für unsere Kollektionen und den Versand im EU-Ausland steuern

In den ersten Monaten arbeitest du dich tief in unsere bestehenden Verpackungslösungen und die regulatorischen Vorgaben der EU-Märkte ein. Du übernimmst die Koordination der anfallenden Meldepflichten und stimmst dich eng mit unseren Logistikpartnern ab.

Project Bay ist der erste Coworking-Living Space mit direktem Meerzugang und neuer Hotspot für Innovationen im Norden. Die Themen Digitalisierung, künstliche Intelligenz und neue Mobilitätslösungen werden hierbei mit regionaler Community, Work-Life-Balance und Natur pur verbunden.

jobs.title: Sr. Software Engineer, Cloud Platform
jobs.description:
Sr. Software Engineer, Cloud Platform

Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

As a Senior Engineer in the Infrastructure org, you will help evolve the cloud foundations behind every Samsara product. Your goal will be to reduce systemic production risk and enable continued growth by making infrastructure safer to change, easier to operate, and more resilient and cost-efficient at scale.

You will bring deep expertise in at least one infrastructure domain, such as compute and workload orchestration, networking, storage and stateful systems, or cloud control planes, and apply it across our multi-account, multi-region AWS environment. You will lead work such as modernizing compute and stateful infrastructure, strengthening capacity and failure isolation, and building standardized infrastructure-as-code workflows and reusable automation.

You will partner with product engineering teams to turn recurring risks and manual operations into durable platforms and paved paths. We do not expect you to be an expert in every infrastructure domain. We are looking for engineers who have built and operated critical systems at significant scale, understand how infrastructure fails, and can use that experience to improve both our platforms and our engineering practices.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: The software, firmware, and hardware you build will result in real-world impact, helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You are a life-long learner: We have ambitious goals. Every Samsarian has a growth mindset as we work with a wide range of technologies, challenges, and customers that push us to learn on the go.
  • You believe customers are more than a number: Samsara engineers enjoy a rare closeness to the end user and you will have the opportunity to participate in customer interviews, collaborate with customer success and product managers, and use metrics to ensure our work is translating into better customer outcomes.
  • You are a team player: Working on our Samsara Engineering teams requires a mix of independent effort and collaboration. Motivated by our mission, we're all racing toward our connected operations vision, and we intend to win together.

In this role, you will: 

  • Design, build, and operate reliable cloud platforms, bringing depth in one or more areas such as compute, networking, storage, stateful systems, or infrastructure control planes.
  • Improve the scalability, capacity management, isolation, recovery, and cost efficiency of critical production infrastructure.
  • Build standardized infrastructure-as-code workflows and reusable automation that support self-service provisioning, testing, progressive rollout, reconciliation, rollback, and drift prevention. 
  • Identify shared failure modes and build safeguards that prevent localized failures from escalating into broad customer impact.
  • Contribute to multi-account, multi-region, and isolated AWS architectures, including regulated environments such as GovCloud.
  • Participate in operational ownership and incident response, using incidents and near misses to drive durable architectural improvements.
  • Mentor engineers, raise the quality of infrastructure design and operational judgment, and establish patterns that can be adopted across the organization.
  • Clearly communicate architecture, trade-offs, risks, and migration plans to technical and organizational stakeholders.
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices.

Minimum requirements for this role.

  • 6+ years of experience designing and building software, infrastructure, or distributed systems, including operating critical systems in production.
  • Deep expertise in at least one of the following: compute and workload orchestration, networking, storage and stateful systems, or cloud infrastructure control planes.
  • Strong software-engineering fundamentals in Go, Python, Java, or a similar language.
  • Hands-on experience designing and operating infrastructure on a major public cloud platform; AWS experience is preferred.
  • Experience using infrastructure as code, such as Terraform, to safely manage production infrastructure.
  • Strong understanding of capacity management, failure domains, observability, rollout safety, and production recovery.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead complex technical initiatives across teams and through ambiguous problem spaces.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Designing and operating large-scale compute or container platforms such as ECS, EKS, Kubernetes, or similar orchestration systems.
  • Designing and operating stateful distributed systems such as Kafka, OpenSearch, managed databases, caching, or large-scale storage platforms.
  • Building internal infrastructure platforms, control planes, or self-service developer experiences adopted across multiple teams.
  • Designing multi-account or multi-region cloud architectures with strong workload isolation and disaster recovery.
  • Leading major infrastructure migrations while maintaining availability and controlling operational risk.
  • Delivering measurable improvements in infrastructure capacity, cost efficiency, or developer self-service.

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working 

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations 

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara's Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in ----- ----- or ----- For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

More than 200,000 developers and 1,300+ organizations build voice offerings that are ‘Powered by Deepgram’, including Twilio, Cloudflare, Sierra, Decagon, Vapi, Daily, Cresta, Granola, and Jack in the Box. Backed by a recent Series C led by leading global investors and strategic partners, Deepgram has processed over 50,000 years of audio and transcribed more than 1 trillion words. There is no organization in the world that understands voice better than Deepgram.

Company Operating Rhythm

At Deepgram, we expect an AI-first mindset—AI use and comfort aren’t optional, they’re core to how we operate, innovate, and measure performance.

Every team member who works at Deepgram is expected to actively use and experiment with advanced AI tools, and even build your own into your everyday work. We measure how effectively AI is applied to deliver results, and consistent, creative use of the latest AI capabilities is key to success here. Candidates should be comfortable adopting new models and modes quickly, integrating AI into their workflows, and continuously pushing the boundaries of what these technologies can do.

Additionally, we move at the pace of AI. Change is rapid, and you can expect your day-to-day work to evolve just as quickly. This may not be the right role if you’re not excited to experiment, adapt, think on your feet, and learn constantly, or if you’re seeking something highly prescriptive with a traditional 9-to-5.

We’re looking for an exceptional commercial lawyer to join our lean, high-impact legal team as our second commercial lawyer. This role is for someone who thrives at the intersection of law and business strategy — a deal-maker with sharp instincts, sound judgment, and genuine excitement about what Deepgram is building and how we are changing what is possible with speech.

Our legal team has a real seat at the table. You’ll close deals that matter, shape legal strategy at the frontier of AI, and craft commercial frameworks that are being built for the first time in this space. You’ll also help establish a legal function that scales with a company on a steep trajectory, reporting directly to our AssociateGeneral Counsel (Commercial). About AIOS

AIOS is building the world’s first full-stack AI doctor.

We’re at $450M ARR, growing from $7M/yr in April 2025. We’re faithfully serving >200k/mo patients via Bolt Pharmacy, our main UK brand. We’ve just launched Bolt Med, our international brand. We’re profitable.

Our strategy exists at the intersection of two strong theses:

  1. The AI doctor that wins will get to escape velocity using GLP-1s, the fastest growing consumer product in history.

  2. The $2T European healthcare market is overlooked by the most talented builders.

Our master plan:

  • Step 0 → $100M/yr by end of 2025: We went from $10M to $100M in 6 months serving the UK GLP-1 market.

  • Step 1 → $1B ARR by end of 2026: Since April 2025 we've grown from 3k to 200k UK active GLP-1 patients. We’ll continue this growth curve to hit $1B ARR.

  • Step 2 → $10B ARR by end of 2028: Blitzscale Europe. We’ll be Europe’s largest GLP-1 provider.

  • Step 3 → $100B/yr by end of 2030: Get regulatory approval across Europe for our Full Autonomous Prescribing (FAP) system. Win contracts at scale with European payers to mass replace human labor. We’ll be the dominant full-stack AI doctor in Europe.

  • Step 4 → $1T/yr by end of 2035: With one line of code and zero human time, you can use AIOS to treat any patient globally with any medication.

In so doing, we’ll become the world’s first trillion-dollar healthcare company.

We’re a young, founder-led company. This is still Day 1 and all our work is ahead of us.

You can read more about working with us here: Working at AIOS

Being a Talent Lead at AIOS

We’re building a world-class team. As Talent Lead at AIOS, your fundamental role is to supercharge our talent (recruiting) function, ensuring that a lack of key hires never blocks growth. You’ll help define what a killer sourcing process looks like while leveraging frontier tooling to increase your throughput and velocity as you recruit best-in-class operators.

You’ll work across a variety of roles: traditional direct-to-consumer Growth roles (Performance Marketing), technical roles (AI + SWE Engineering & Product), and clinical roles — flexing deftly between more junior roles all the way up to the most senior roles in the org.

This is a full-time, fully remote role, and you’ll work mostly async in the timezone of your choice — as long as you’re around until midday Pacific Time every weekday. You’ll have flex in your calendar for kids if you have them — many of our team have kids so we’re kid-friendly.

This is an individual-contributor role — no direct reports, full-cycle sourcing/screening/closing, hands dirty in the trenches. You’ll report directly to Cierra Olsen (Head of Talent).

You’ll also work closely with the rest of the Talent Team: Zoe Wheeler (UK Talent Lead), Mika Mansilla (Founder Associate), and Jordan Pellikan (VP Ops).

Key responsibilities

  • Full cycle: Own searches end to end from sourcing, outbound, screening, interview coordination, calibration, and closing (recent examples: Head of InfoSec, Head of Creative, Senior Media Buyer, Affiliate Lead).

  • Sourcing: Build repeatable sourcing engines for hard-to-fill roles. Run LinkedIn X-ray searches, build target-company lists, and do the outbound headhunting yourself. Our best hires won’t come inbound.

  • Processes: Constantly sharpen our hiring bars (seniority, industry fit, recency, builder pattern) consistently across every search you’re DRI for. Help improve interview processes across the org.

  • Hygiene: Keep pipelines, stages, and candidate communication clean and current in Ashby so nothing stalls and our time to hire continually improves.

  • Calibration: Flag pipeline risk early, bring calibration questions before they become misses, and constantly align with leaders across the org to improve our processes.

  • Closing: Manage candidate experience through to signed offer, including comp conversations.

KPIs

  • Time-to-fill on your owned searches, without sacrificing the bar

  • Sourced (outbound) candidates as a % of your total pipeline — we want you building your own pipeline, not living off inbound

  • Offer-accept rate on closed candidates

  • Ashby pipeline hygiene — stages and candidate status always current

Need to have

  • Excellence: You have 5+ years experience personally recruiting (sourcing, screening, managing, and closing) great candidates across difficult searches. You can point to hires that materially raised the talent bar of the teams they joined.

  • Hunter: You can turn a vague candidate profile into target companies, search strings and a high-quality outbound pipeline. You do not depend on inbound applicants or agencies to fill roles.

  • Senior hiring: You have successfully recruited senior leaders and understand how sourcing, assessing and closing them differs from junior hiring.

  • Judgment: You can distinguish exceptional people from candidates who simply have the right companies, titles or polish on their CV. You develop conviction quickly and can clearly articulate why someone does or does not meet the bar.

  • Range: You can move between very different searches without losing depth. You learn unfamiliar markets quickly enough to recruit credibly within them.

  • Multi-workstream: You can run several searches simultaneously while keeping sourcing quality, candidate communication, follow-ups and pipeline hygiene exceptionally tight.

  • Urgency: You push searches forward without waiting to be managed, surface problems early, and change approach quickly when a pipeline is not working.

  • High bar: You care more about making an exceptional hire than filling a seat, and you are comfortable challenging hiring managers when you do not believe a candidate meets org standards.

Nice to have

  • Startups/Scale-ups: You’ve recruited in a fast-moving startup or scale-up where priorities shift quickly, roles evolve mid-search, and there isn’t always an existing playbook.

  • Technical recruiting: You’ve successfully recruited for Engineering, AI, Data, Product or other technical roles and can credibly assess candidate quality beyond surface-level credentials.

  • Regulated industries: You’ve recruited in healthcare, financial services, or another highly regulated industry where candidate requirements and operating constraints are more complex.

  • AI-native: You actively use AI and automation to improve sourcing, research, outreach, screening, and recruiting operations.

  • Systems builder: You’ve helped build or materially improve recruiting processes, tooling, scorecards, sourcing systems, or interview loops rather than simply operating an existing process.

  • Network: You have an existing network of exceptional operators, builders and leaders you’d be excited to bring into AIOS.

Our cultural standards

We aim to make this your life's work. This should be the most challenging, most rewarding role of your life. Accordingly, these are the core cultural standards to which we hold ourselves & our team-members:

  1. Belief in the mission: We will have served 100 million patients by the end of 2035 and we transform the life of most patients who join. We have a lot of work to do. We are obsessed with our patients and are dedicated to the mission.

  2. Unwavering integrity: We are at the frontier, so we often live in ambiguity with no trodden path. When we can't look to others for guidance, we must maintain impeccable ethics and unwavering integrity.

  3. Only the paranoid survive: Bad sh*t is coming. By joining us, you're choosing to sail straight towards the storms with unhesitating conviction. However much we've already done, however far we've already come — it's still Day 1 and all our work is ahead of us.

  4. If we're average we fail: We are only interested in "insanely great", a focus on the quality of our execution that in everyday life would be considered pathological. We have a dedication to excellence and reject incompetence.

  5. Commitment to candor: That which can be destroyed by the truth should be. You get full transparency from the company and the company expects full transparency from you. We never say anything about someone that we wouldn't say to them directly. We give feedback with love and do not need to protect people from fleeting physical sensations.

  6. A maniacal sense of urgency: We execute at an intensity that most people think is impossible. Speed is critical and we need things done yesterday. We all work very hard and in such a competitive world there really is no other way to win.

  7. Enduring frugality: We are frugal. We hate being wasteful and we are anti-luxury. A culture of cheapness keeps us young. We spend our cash wisely & carefully — in a way that would make our grandmas proud.

  8. Bulldozing barriers: The world is malleable and we shape it. We truly believe this and act accordingly. We are relentlessly resourceful and are at the mercy of no-one but ourselves. You'll be shocked how capable you are and how much you can achieve.

  9. Keep your head down: We're boring people doing exciting work. We don't chase short-term status — we ignore short-term dopamine hits and focus on what matters. Outsiders will underestimate us and we revel in that.

  10. The power of focus: We live in a world of power laws and we cannot overestimate the unimportance of practically everything. Know your One Thing, and nail it.

    🎯 "You just build a f\*ing amazing experience. Make each step amazing. Make every decision in the long term interest of the customer. Give the customer massively more value than you take."

Compensation & Benefits

You get paid above market salary and you get early stage equity, so you get really rich if we nail this.

  • Compensation: $100k-$200k/yr, incl equity

Benefits

The stuff below is cool as well.

  • Healthcare: comprehensive medical insurance (if appropriate).

  • Work coaching: free biweekly work coaching so you stay sharp + calm.

  • Equipment: Macbook & work-from-home equipment provided as needed.

  • What are we missing? We're still early so you get to shape our culture.

jobs.title: (Senior) Deployment Strategist
jobs.description:
(Senior) Deployment Strategist

You take a signed customer and turn them into a flagship reference, owning the journey from first go-live to a full rollout across their plants.

Ethon was built to eliminate the trillion-dollar waste problem in manufacturing. We are the technology leader in Industrial AI, building agentic workflows that help manufacturers optimize cost, quality, and speed of production. We serve manufacturers from Siemens and Bosch to Lindt and Roche, and are backed by Index Ventures, General Catalyst, and Earlybird. Our team draws from Palantir, McKinsey, Meta, Google, and top manufacturing companies, all here for the same reason: giving manufacturers the technology to run every factory at unprecedented productivity.

WHAT IS THIS JOB ABOUT?

You will take a signed logo and turn them into a flagship reference. That means getting onto the shopfloor fast, understanding what drives their KPIs, and deploying Ethon's agentic workflows where the impact is highest. You implement the first use case while already mapping the next. Once one is live, you find the next one. When the engineer is sold, you bring in the plant manager. Once the plant manager is convinced, you get to the COO. This is what you'll do:

  • Own the deployment: You're the person who makes sure go-live happens on time and the customer's team knows how to use it. You handle the onboarding, the training, and the change management that gets a new platform embedded into daily operations.

  • Turn shopfloor problems into business cases: An operator tells you yield drops on line 3 every Tuesday night. You figure out why, quantify what it costs, and build the case for the next deployment. You're as comfortable talking to a process engineer as you are presenting to a VP of Operations.

  • Drive expansion: You know which teams in the account haven't seen Ethon yet, which problems are still unsolved, and what it takes to get the next use case signed.

  • Be on-site: You're in factories. The insights that matter don't come from email chains and slides, they come from being on the floor.

  • Feed the product: You're closest to what customers actually need. You bring that signal back to Engineering and Product and you help us build something better.

  • Work with the team: GTM & Sales brings the logo with your help as a trustworthy industry expert, you take it from there. You work tightly with Engineering on delivery and with the commercial team on expansion opportunities.

WHAT DO YOU NEED TO BRING?

The best people in this seat combine strategic thinking with the willingness to get their hands dirty on a shopfloor. We can teach you our product. We can't teach you to care about how things get made, or to push hard when a deployment is stuck.

  • You're technically sharp enough to understand a production process and commercially minded enough to turn a pain point into a business case

  • You have 3-5 years of experience in something demanding: consulting, enterprise tech deployment, or a career on the shopfloor

  • You know how to manage complex stakeholder environments, from shopfloor operators to C-suite sponsors

  • You've run change management or adoption programs and know what it takes to get people to actually use new tools

  • You have a builder mindset: when something isn't working, your instinct is to fix it rather than escalate it

  • You're open to travel 30-50% of the time

This is how we'll set you up in your first six months:

  • Months 1-2: Learn about product, customers, and how our best deployments get done. You shadow live accounts, learn the platform end-to-end, and expand your understanding of how manufacturers think. You start working on your first account.

  • Months 3-4: You own delivery for one or more accounts, with support from the team.

  • Months 5-6: Full ownership of one or more customers. You're running deployments, driving expansion conversations, and your first upsell is in motion.

Great fits tend to come from backgrounds like:

  • Deployment, implementation, or customer success at high-growth industrial tech companies (e.g., Palantir, c3ai, Rockwell, Siemens Digital Industries) where you owned outcomes

jobs.title: CFO (Mitglied der Geschäftsleitung)
jobs.description:
CFO (Mitglied der Geschäftsleitung)

Das Universitäre Zentrum für Zahnmedizin Basel (UZB) vereint Patientenbehandlung, akademische Lehre und Forschung unter einem Dach. Mit rund 300 Mitarbeitenden, rund 100'000 Behandlungen pro Jahr und einem Umsatz von ca. CHF 40 Mio. erbringt das UZB seine Leistungen unter anderem auf Basis von Leistungsaufträgen mit der Universität Basel und dem Kanton Basel-Stadt. Wir suchen eine oder einen CFO mit überzeugenden betriebswirtschaftlichen und finanziellen Kenntnissen. Als Mitglied der Geschäftsleitung ist neben dem Finanzwissen auch unternehmerisches Denken und Handeln gefragt, um das Unternehmen gesamtheitlich zu steuern und weiterzuentwickeln.

Ihre Verantwortung

  • Sie verantworten die finanzielle Führung des UZB – von der Budget-, Liquiditäts- und Finanzplanung über das Rechnungswesen und die Rechnungslegung nach Swiss GAAP FER bis hin zum Controlling – und stellen ein aussagekräftiges, stufengerechtes Reporting an unsere Leitungserbringer, die Geschäftsleitung und den Verwaltungsrat sicher.

  • Sie sichern die Finanzierung und Liquidität, entwickeln das Risikomanagement und das interne Kontrollsystem weiter und sind Ansprechperson für den Prüfungsausschuss des Verwaltungsrats und die Revisionsstelle.

  • Sie führen und entwickeln die Bereiche Finanzen (rund 10 Mitarbeitende), IT (3), Technischer Dienst (3) und Einkauf mit vier direkt unterstellten Führungspersonen und fördern die Zusammenarbeit über Fachgrenzen hinweg.

  • Sie bringen die Digitalisierung und Weiterentwicklung von Abläufen und Systemen voran und entscheiden bei der laufenden Evaluation einer neuen ERP-Lösung massgeblich mit.

  • Als Mitglied der Geschäftsleitung tragen Sie auch die gesamtunternehmerische Verantwortung mit und bringen sich in Fragen der Unternehmensentwicklung aktiv ein.

  • Sie beraten die CEO und die Geschäftsleitung als Sparringpartner in allen betriebswirtschaftlichen Fragen und erarbeiten Business Cases für neue Angebote und Projekte.

  • Sie schaffen Entscheidungsgrundlagen für den Dialog mit internen und externen Anspruchsgruppen in einem öffentlich-rechtlich geprägten Umfeld und pflegen den Kontakt zu den relevanten Stakeholdern.

Ihr beruflicher Hintergrund

  • Sie verfügen über substanzielles Know-how in Finanzen und Controlling sowie über Erfahrung in einer verantwortlichen Finanzführungsfunktion.

  • Sie haben einen (Fach-) Hochschulstudium in Betriebswirtschaft abgeschlossen oder sind Expertin bzw. Experte in Rechnungslegung und Controlling; Erfahrung mit Swiss GAAP FER und SAP ist von Vorteil.

  • Sie haben Führungserfahrung, sind es gewohnt bei Entscheidungsprozessen mitzuwirken und anschliessend die Entscheidungen in ihrem Verantwortungsbereich konsequent umzusetzen. Sie kommunizieren differenziert und transparent, arbeiten pragmatisch und verbinden finanzielle Sorgfalt mit Offenheit für neue Lösungen.

  • Sie verfügen über stilsichere Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse.

  • Sie interessieren sich für Digitalisierung und einen verantwortungsvollen Umgang mit Daten und neuen Technologien.

  • Erfahrung im Gesundheitswesen oder in einer öffentlich-rechtlichen Organisation sind willkommen, doch keine Voraussetzung.

Was die Aufgabe auszeichnet

Das UZB ist eine dynamische Institution: 2016 gegründet und seit 2021 um rund 30 % gewachsen. Unsere Strukturen, Prozesse und Systeme lassen sich aktiv mitprägen. Sie verbinden eine finanzielle Schlüsselrolle mit der Möglichkeit, die Weiterentwicklung einer Unternehmung mit gesellschaftlichem Auftrag aus Geschäftsleitungsperspektive mitzugestalten. Die Position verlangt Nähe zum Tagesgeschäft ebenso wie einen verlässlichen Blick auf das Ganze.

jobs.title: Onderzoeksstage Water en Ruimte
jobs.description:
Onderzoeksstage Water en Ruimte

24-40 uur per week | Utrecht | Hybride | € 600,- stagevergoeding | Wo-bachelor/-master

Jouw vooruitgang begint bij Berenschot

Waterbeheer heeft wonen, werken en leven in Nederland mogelijk gemaakt. Dat systeem is over honderden jaren opgebouwd en ingericht op een gematigd klimaat. Met zeespiegelstijging, droogte en zware neerslag lopen we nu tegen de grenzen aan. Drinkwaterbedrijven luiden de noodklok over leveringszekerheid en piekbuien wisselen af met extreme droogte. Water is bepalend voor waar we kunnen bouwen, werken en leven. Om weerbaar te worden moeten we andere keuzes maken over de inrichting en het gebruik van onze leefomgeving, waarbij functies beter aansluiten op de draagkracht van het water- en bodemsysteem.

Elke dag worden er nieuwe ruimtelijke keuzes gemaakt, bijvoorbeeld over woningbouw, bedrijfsuitbreiding of het energiesysteem. Om daarin meer rekening te houden met water en bodem moeten de wereld van water en bodem en de wereld van ruimtelijke ordening beter samenwerken en elkaars taal leren spreken. Daarvoor bestaan al instrumenten, methoden en werkwijzen, zoals Omgevingstafels, de Watertoets, blauwe omgevingsvisies en water- en bodemsysteemanalyses. Maar werken die instrumenten ook echt, en wat is er nodig om ze beter te laten aansluiten op de praktijk? Dat zoeken wij uit.

Wil jij aan het begin van jouw loopbaan direct meewerken aan onderzoek dat bijdraagt aan de koers van Nederland? Bij Berenschot werk je in een dynamisch team van adviseurs op het gebied van water en ruimte. Je krijgt de kans om jezelf te ontwikkelen én tegelijkertijd maatschappelijke impact te maken.

Dit ga je doen

Jouw onderzoek:

Je maakt een inventarisatie van bestaande en nieuwe, innovatieve instrumenten en methoden, en/of je formuleert succesfactoren voor één specifiek instrument (een best practice). Samen met jou en je begeleiders bepalen we de precieze afbakening.

Je onderzoek is onderdeel van het project Kwartiermaker water- en bodemsysteemanalyses (Interprovinciaal Overleg en het ministerie van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat). Mogelijke resultaten zijn een bijdrage aan de analyse en toolbox van het kwartiermakerschap, een publicatie over best practices, of een instrumentenkoffer voor waterschappen, provincies en het ministerie van IenW.

Je bent daarmee onderdeel van het kwartiermakerverhaal, maar blijft niet bij één project. Voor je onderzoek kun je ook putten uit andere lopende trajecten van ons team, zoals het Deltaprogramma Ruimtelijke Adaptatie (DPRA). Daar spelen vergelijkbare vragen over hoe je samenwerking tussen overheden en regio’s echt werkend krijgt. Zo haal je extra inzichten en praktijkvoorbeelden op en zie je hoe verschillende dossiers elkaar versterken.

Naast je eigen onderzoek werk samen met een team van ervaren adviseurs aan maatschappelijke dossiers voor ministeries, provincies, waterschappen en drinkwaterbedrijven:

  • Aansluiten bij werksessies en de reflectiekring: je ziet hoe bijeenkomsten met bestuurders, beleidsmakers en wetenschappers worden gestructureerd en werkt de uitkomsten uit tot heldere syntheses.

  • Analyseren en schrijven: je voert interviews uit, analyseert beleidsdocumenten en schrijft mee aan rapportages en publicaties.

  • Initiatief nemen: je werkt mee aan inhoudelijke kennissessies en netwerkevenementen om het watercluster van Berenschot op de kaart te zetten.

Hier kom je terecht

Berenschot is een zelfstandig en onafhankelijk Nederlands organisatieadviesbureau in Utrecht, waar we met meer dan 500 gedreven collega’s werken aan duurzame oplossingen voor de vraagstukken van onze opdrachtgevers. We dragen bij aan vooruitgang in organisaties en de maatschappij met onze adviezen en oplossingen. Onze organisatie heeft een platte structuur zonder partners, waardoor je invloed hebt op de projecten die je uitvoert. We streven altijd naar verrassende en vernieuwende oplossingen, wat ons uniek maakt. Met een open en informele cultuur, samenwerking tussen verschillende vakgebieden en veel vrijheid en verantwoordelijkheid vanaf dag één, krijg je de kans om te ontdekken wat je belangrijk vindt, waar je kracht ligt en waarin jij je wilt ontwikkelen.

Dit zijn je directe collega’s

Je maakt deel uit van het team Duurzame Leefomgeving; een groep van 22 bevlogen adviseurs met specialisaties in ruimtelijke ordening, planologie en bestuurskunde. Dit team is onderdeel van de adviesgroep Energie en Leefomgeving, waarin zeventig adviseurs samenwerken aan diverse vraagstukken in de fysieke leefomgeving. Je werkt in wisselende projectteams om iedere opdracht optimaal te bemensen, waarbij we naast het inhoudelijke vraagstuk ook governance, organisatie-inrichting, veranderopgaven en regionale samenwerking meenemen in onze advisering.


Dit neem je mee

Je bent een nieuwsgierige en analytisch sterke student die maatschappelijke vraagstukken weet te verbinden met onderzoek en praktijk.

Daarnaast:

  • volg je een masteropleiding in de richting van planologie, watermanagement, omgevingswetenschappen of een vergelijkbare studie

  • heb je affiniteit met vraagstukken rondom water, klimaatadaptatie, ruimtelijke ordening of publieke samenwerking

  • beschik je over sterke analytische en communicatieve vaardigheden

  • werk je zelfstandig, maar zoek je actief de samenwerking op

  • beheers je de Nederlandse taal goed, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk

Om stage te kunnen lopen bij Berenschot, moet je gedurende de gehele stageperiode ingeschreven staan bij een universitaire onderwijsinstelling. Studenten van Wageningen University & Research, Rijksuniversiteit Groningen, Universiteit van Amsterdam, TU Delft en Radboud Universiteit worden nadrukkelijk uitgenodigd om te reageren.

Dit bieden we jou

  • Een uitdagende onderzoeksstage voor 5 tot 6 maanden.

  • Een marktconforme stagevergoeding van € 600,- per maand (op fulltimebasis).

  • Intensieve begeleiding door ervaren adviseurs en inhoudelijk experts.

  • De mogelijkheid om een directe bijdrage te leveren aan actuele maatschappelijke opgaven.

  • Een waardevol professioneel netwerk binnen ministeries, provincies, waterschappen en kennisinstellingen.

  • Een stage waarin onderzoek en praktijk nauw met elkaar verbonden zijn.

  • De kans om ervaring op te doen in een dynamische adviesomgeving en jezelf verder te ontwikkelen als onderzoeker en adviseur.

Stageplusprogramma

Naast je stage kun je deelnemen aan het stageplusprogramma van Berenschot: een opleidingsprogramma van circa 3,5 maand dat trainingen biedt op het gebied van advieskennis, -vaardigheden en persoonlijke ontwikkeling. Dit vraagt gemiddeld één dagdeel per twee weken. Via deze link lees je meer over het programma. Alles over ons stageplusprogramma | Berenschot

Solliciteer meteen

Spreekt deze stage je aan? Wacht niet langer en solliciteer! Neem contact op met Oumnia Makrani via WhatsApp (06 13 33 87 70) of per e-mail () voor informatie over de procedure. Oumnia is op vrijdag bereikbaar. Heb je een dringende vraag? Mail dan naar .

Ben je nieuwsgierig naar hoe bedrijven en organisaties in de Nederlandse industrie zijn georganiseerd? Wil je bijdragen aan de verbetering en vernieuwing van toonaangevende bedrijven? Wil je samen met een team consultants bijdragen aan complexe vraagstukken, het ontwikkelen van slimme inzichten en deze vertalen naar strategische oplossingen? Dan is deze stage bij Berenschot iets voor jou.

In deze meewerkstage help je mee aan het oplossen van strategische en operationele vraagstukken van klanten uit de industrie: je bekijkt hun grootste uitdagingen op het gebied van strategische positionering, product- en marktkeuzes,, procesoptimalisatie en digitalisering.

Dit ga je doen

Je gaat meewerken aan diverse opdrachten voor klanten uit de industrie en het bredere bedrijfsleven, zoals het ontwikkelen van een nieuwe strategie, het in beeld brengen van een markt of sector, het verbeteren van de operationele processen, het implementeren van technologische innovaties en het organiseren van transformaties voor groei en prestatieverbetering. Bij ‘industrie’ denken we onder meer aan de maakindustrie, defensie-industrie, voedselverwerkende industrie en hightechindustrie.

Je komt te werken in een platte organisatie die altijd openstaat voor nieuwe en innovatieve ideeën, waar je veel vrijheid krijgt om te leren én om mee te denken.

Voorbeelden van projecten waaraan jij meehelpt:

  • Begeleiding van strategische workshops om de strategie van de organisatie te herijken.

  • Doen van marktonderzoek voor een servicepartner in scheepsmotoren.

  • Verbeteren van de kwaliteit en doorlooptijd van het productieproces bij een fabrikant van auto-onderdelen door toepassing van Lean Six Sigma.

  • Optimaliseren van productieprocessen door gebruik van data van een producent van verzorgingsproducten.

  • Realiseren van bedrijfsbrede performanceverbetering en kostenbesparing bij een offshore-organisatie.

Daarnaast help je mee aan het schrijven van offertes en het maken van pitchdecks van nieuwe opdrachten en het verder ontwikkelen van onze dienstverlening. Het is mogelijk om een stageonderzoek parallel te doen aan je periode bij Berenschot zolang er ook voldoende tijd beschikbaar blijft om te helpen met klantopdrachten en je daarin te ontwikkelen.

Quote

‘Bij Berenschot bepaal je vaak zelf wat je wilt leren en als stagiair werk je meteen mee aan echte projecten bij onze klanten.’ — Nick Fierloos, junior consultant (voormalig stagiair)

Hier kom je terecht

Berenschot is een zelfstandig en onafhankelijk Nederlands organisatieadviesbureau in Utrecht, waar we met meer dan 500 gedreven collega’s werken aan duurzame oplossingen voor de vraagstukken van onze opdrachtgevers. Onze organisatie heeft een platte structuur zonder partners, waardoor je invloed hebt op de projecten die je uitvoert. We streven altijd naar verrassende en vernieuwende oplossingen, wat ons uniek maakt. Met een open en informele cultuur, samenwerking tussen verschillende vakgebieden en veel vrijheid en verantwoordelijkheid vanaf dag één, krijg je de kans om te ontdekken wat je belangrijk vindt, waar je kracht ligt en waarin jij je wilt ontwikkelen.

Dit zijn je directe collega’s

Je gaat werken in het team Strategy & Operations, onderdeel van de adviesgroep Transformatie van Organisaties. Het team bestaat uit zeventien slimme en enthousiaste adviseurs die werken in verschillende sectoren. Zij combineren hun kennis van de markt, strategie en operationele bedrijfsprocessen om scherpe analyses en adviezen te maken. Het team kenmerkt zich door een sterke collegiale band waarbij hard werken, teamwork, het beste uit jezelf en elkaar te halen, impact en plezier maken hand in hand gaan. Met slimme en gedreven Berenschotters om je heen werk je samen aan oplossingen die er écht toe doen.

jobs.title: Senior Enterprise Systems Engineer
jobs.description:
Senior Enterprise Systems Engineer

1Password is growing. We’ve surpassed $500M in ARR and we’re continuing to accelerate, earning a spot on the Forbes Cloud 100 for four years in a row and teaming up with iconic partners like Oracle Red Bull Racing.

About 1Password

At 1Password, we’re building the foundation for a safe, productive digital future. Our mission is to unleash employee productivity without compromising security by ensuring every identity is authentic, every application sign-in is secure, and every device is trusted. We innovated the market-leading enterprise password manager and pioneered Unified Access Management, a new cybersecurity category built for the way people and AI agents work today. As one of the most loved brands in cybersecurity, we take a human-centric approach in everything from product strategy to user experience. Over 180,000 businesses, from Fortune 100 leaders to the world’s most innovative AI companies, trust 1Password to help their teams securely adopt the SaaS and AI tools they need to do their best work.

If you're excited about the opportunity to contribute to the digital safety of millions, to work alongside a team of curious, driven individuals, and to solve hard problems in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, then we want to hear from you. Come join us and help shape a safer, simpler digital future.

Enterprise Systems at 1Password owns the tools and systems the company runs on. We centrally select, administer, integrate, and govern Enterprise Tools so that they work together as an interconnected ecosystem that shapes how 1Password operates. The team is charting new territory: centralizing ownership of company tools, building cross-functional integrations, and enabling the company to adopt new technologies, including AI, responsibly and strategically.

The Senior Enterprise Systems Engineer is a key technical contributor on this team. You'll own the lifecycle and roadmap for a portfolio of Tier 1 enterprise tools, work closely with the team's Staff Engineer, and partner with Security, Finance, Legal, and business teams. You'll also bring practical AI and automation skills to your work. If you enjoy building scalable systems, solving workflow problems with automation, and raising the bar for those around you, we want to hear from you.

How we’re using AI today

Our Engineering, Product, and Design teams are thoughtfully integrating AI across the full software and product development lifecycle to move faster without sacrificing quality or security. In practice, that looks like engineers using AI-assisted coding tools to accelerate reviews and catch bugs earlier, product managers synthesizing user research at scale, and designers rapidly prototyping and iterating with AI-generated mockups. We approach AI the same way we approach security: with clear principles, human accountability at every consequential decision point, and rigorous evaluation before anything ships to customers.

This is a remote opportunity within the US or Canada.

What we're looking for:

  • 5+ years of IT or enterprise systems experience, with a track record of building and supporting enterprise systems at scale.

  • Hands-on expertise administering, integrating, and optimizing core enterprise platforms such as Slack, Google Workspace, Zoom, Notion, Jira, Asana, or similar.

  • Experience with identity and access management concepts, including SSO, SCIM provisioning, and access reviews (Okta preferred).

  • Experience with workflow automation and integration tools such as Tines, Okta Workflows, Workato, or APIs and low-code/no-code platforms.

  • Practical experience with AI-enabled productivity tools or platforms (e.g., ChatGPT Enterprise, Dust, Claude, Glean), with an understanding of secure and responsible AI adoption.

  • Ability to build and communicate a strategic roadmap for a tool or portfolio, and to translate business workflow challenges into effective technical solutions.

  • Familiarity with software licensing, procurement, and vendor management (a plus).

  • Strong collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to work with both technical and non-technical stakeholders in a rapidly scaling organization.

  • A desire to mentor others and contribute to a positive team culture.

Success in this role looks like:

  • Your assigned tools are configured, maintained, and operating reliably, meeting team standards for uptime, security posture, and employee adoption.

  • Each tool you own has a documented roadmap aligned with company needs and vendor direction.

  • Licenses, renewals, and provisioning are managed efficiently, with clear ownership and no grey zones between IT and the business.

  • Integrations and configurations are documented and follow consistent standards.

  • AI features and automations in your area are rolled out securely and adopted, with measurable reductions in manual effort.

  • Partners across IT, Security, Finance, Legal, and the business see you as a trusted, responsive point of contact.

What you can expect:

  • Own the end-to-end lifecycle of an assigned portfolio of Tier 1 tools (e.g., Slack, Google Workspace, Zoom, Notion, Jira, Asana, Freshservice), including administration, configuration, support, and documentation.

jobs.title: Privacy Program Manager
jobs.description:
Privacy Program Manager

About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Privacy Program Manager to join our Legal Team and help build and scale ElevenLabs’ global privacy program. In this role, you will translate privacy requirements into effective, repeatable processes across the company and drive the day-to-day operation of key privacy initiatives.

You will work closely with Legal, Product, Engineering, Security, Safety, and GTM teams to operationalize privacy-by-design, manage privacy assessments and compliance workflows, and strengthen the systems and processes that support ElevenLabs’ growing global business. This role is ideal for someone who combines deep privacy program experience with strong project management skills and enjoys building scalable programs in a fast-moving AI environment.

Responsibilities

  • Manage and continuously improve ElevenLabs’ global privacy program, translating legal and regulatory requirements into scalable operational processes and controls.

  • Own and coordinate privacy compliance workflows across frameworks including GDPR, CCPA/CPRA, US state privacy laws, HIPAA, and applicable biometric privacy requirements.

  • Manage privacy impact assessment processes, including Privacy Impact Assessments (PIAs), Data Protection Impact Assessments (DPIAs), and assessments involving AI systems, biometric data, voice technologies, health information, and other sensitive data.

  • Partner with Product, Engineering, Legal, and Security teams to operationalize privacy-by-design throughout the product development lifecycle.

  • Maintain data inventories, records of processing activities (RoPAs), data flow documentation, and other privacy governance records.

  • Manage processes for data subject and consumer rights requests, including access, deletion, correction, and opt-out requests, and help ensure requests are handled consistently and within applicable deadlines.

  • Partner with Security and Legal on third-party and vendor privacy assessments, data processing requirements, and privacy-related risk remediation.

  • Support privacy incident response and regulatory or customer inquiries by coordinating documentation, stakeholders, timelines, and follow-up actions.

  • Implement and administer privacy tooling and automation to improve the efficiency and scalability of privacy operations including maintaining ElevenLabs’ consent management platform and partnering with Legal, Marketing, Product, and Engineering to ensure cookie, tracking technology, and other consent and preference mechanisms are appropriately configured, documented, monitored, and updated as our products and regulatory requirements evolve.

  • Develop privacy program metrics, dashboards, and reporting to track compliance, identify risks, and communicate program maturity and priorities to stakeholders.

  • Develop and maintain privacy policies, procedures, playbooks, templates, and internal guidance.

  • Coordinate privacy training and awareness initiatives across the company.

Who you are

  • Excited by AI and emerging technologies and interested in solving novel privacy challenges involving voice, biometrics, health information, and other sensitive data.

  • An exceptional program manager who can turn complex requirements into clear workstreams, owners, milestones, and measurable outcomes.

  • Comfortable operating across Legal, Product, Engineering, Security, and commercial teams and able to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Highly organized and detail-oriented, while able to prioritize effectively and maintain momentum across multiple workstreams.

  • Pragmatic and solutions-oriented, with a strong instinct for building processes that manage risk without creating unnecessary friction.

  • Comfortable building programs and processes from the ground up in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

What you bring

  • 6+ years of experience in privacy program management, privacy operations, data governance, compliance, or a related field, ideally within a technology, SaaS, or AI company.

  • Demonstrated experience operationalizing privacy requirements under frameworks such as GDPR, CCPA/CPRA, and other US state privacy laws as well as sector specific frameworks such as HIPAA and biometric privacy requirements.

  • Technical mindset, you can read a data flow diagram, understand system architectures and keys to data handling and can translate between legal requirements and engineering implementation.

  • Experience building or significantly improving privacy review processes, privacy impact assessments, or privacy control frameworks.

  • Hands-on experience managing consent management platforms and cookie/tracking technology compliance, including consent configuration, preference management, and coordination with technical and marketing teams.

  • Familiarity with security and privacy frameworks such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, or similar.

  • Privacy certifications such as CIPP/US, CIPP/E, CIPM, or CIPT are a plus.

  • Excellent project management, communication, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills.

Location

This role is remote and can be executed in the United States. We have a strong preference for the Eastern time zone, ideally New York.

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

We innovated the market-leading enterprise password manager and pioneered Unified Access Management, a new cybersecurity category built for the way people and AI agents work today. If you're excited about the opportunity to contribute to the digital safety of millions, to work alongside a team of curious, driven individuals, and to solve hard problems in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, then we want to hear from you. Device Infrastructure Services owns the full lifecycle of hardware and operating systems across 1Password. The team is looking for the Staff Engineer who will lead its next chapter: a deliberate shift from legacy device management patterns towards devops and AI-enabled operations.

You'll be the technical leader of this team, responsible for setting the roadmap for this transformation and making sure it gets executed. Our Engineering, Product, and Design teams are thoughtfully integrating AI across the full software and product development lifecycle to move faster without sacrificing quality or security. We approach AI the same way we approach security: with clear principles, human accountability at every consequential decision point, and rigorous evaluation before anything ships to customers.

  • Practical experience using AI tools to enable or accelerate IT operations and the judgment to know where AI speeds things up versus where it introduces risk.

  • Proven ability to define and drive technical roadmaps, seeing around corners and balancing long-term vision with near-term execution.

  • Strong scripting and IaC ability (Bash, Python, and Terraform at minimum) — both writing production-quality automation yourself and reviewing others' code with a critical eye.

  • Deep working knowledge of enterprise security fundamentals as they apply to endpoints: encryption, patch/vulnerability management, EDR, least-privilege enforcement, and compliance frameworks (SOC 2, ISO 27001, or similar).

  • Lead through change, collaborate effectively, and mentor engineers while maintaining a focused and impactful team environment.

  • Lead the adoption of responsible agentic AI across the device team, building the guardrails that decide what agents can act on autonomously and what still needs a human checkpoint.

  • Act as the final escalation point for high-severity endpoint incidents, including deep machine-level diagnosis on both macOS and Windows hardware.

  • Partner across IT, Security, and product teams building custom solutions and helping push their initiatives across the finish line.

  • Assess and pilot new tooling (e.g., MDM platform migrations, patch management systems) and drive build-vs-buy decisions.

  • Collaborate with product teams to advise on features from the perspective of a real-world enterprise device deployment, and lead Customer Zero initiatives — piloting and stress-testing our own product against our internal fleet before it reaches customers.

jobs.description:
Design engineer (UK)

🚀 About WRITER

WRITER is the AI platform built for the world’s most ambitious marketing and revenue teams, bringing the frontier of AI to the people who drive enterprise growth. With WRITER, autonomous agents work across the buyer journey, continuously executing on market signals and enterprise intelligence to grow revenue faster. Every agent action and asset is grounded in trust, built on an Enterprise Brain that unites brand, product, and company knowledge with fiduciary-grade governance and compliance.

Fortune 500 companies are transforming how they go to market with WRITER, including 3 of the top 5 US banks, 2 of the 5 largest global CPG conglomerates, and 4 of the top 5 US healthcare insurers. Founded in 2020, WRITER is backed by investors including Insight Partners, ICONIQ, Radical Ventures, Premji Invest, Balderton, B Capital, Salesforce Ventures, Adobe Ventures, Accenture, Citi Ventures, IBM Ventures, WndrCo, and others. Learn more at WRITER.com.

📐 About the role

Design engineers sit at the intersection of design and engineering. As a design engineer at WRITER, you'll own the Writer Design System (WDS) — how it's built, how it's maintained, and how both humans and AI agents use it to ship product.

This role matters more now than ever. AI coding agents write more of our production code, and they ship whatever they find. A design system that's incomplete or inconsistent doesn't just slow designers down; it gets compounded at scale by every agent that builds against it. You'll make sure WRITER's core UI library is complete and trustworthy enough to build on, working closely with the designers, PMs, and engineers who rely on it every day. You'll help shape the surfaces that define how our product feels to use, and help set the standard and process for how the EPD org ships product.

This is a hybrid role based out of our San Francisco, Chicago, Austin, New York City, Seattle, or London hubs. This role will be reporting to the Director of product design.

We are open to hiring for this role at multiple levels, with compensation ranges scaled to match your experience, expertise, and the scope of the role.

🦸🏻‍♀️ What you'll do

  • Own the Writer Design System (WDS) as your primary domain — agentify and maintain it, ensuring it's optimized for both humans and AI agents building with it

  • Design and build production-quality UI components and features, owning surfaces from sketch to ship

  • Ship design-led work that wouldn't survive an engineering backlog — polish passes, micro-interactions, and brand moments that make the product feel alive

  • Architect new primitives and extend the system's core components, shaping its technical direction while keeping documentation, examples, and libraries in sync across Figma, .md skills, and Storybook

  • Uphold the bar for front-end craft across accessibility, motion feel, consistency, and quality, ensuring accessibility is baked into every design system component

  • Help shape the design-to-code workflow, researching the latest tools and practices to unlock org-wide productivity and democratize workflows across the EPD organization

  • Partner with designers, PMs, and engineering leads to measure WDS adoption, close gaps, and make sure shipped features meet design system standards

⭐️ What you need

  • 4–8+ years building production frontends with TypeScript and React, with a track record of owning a system, platform, or surface end-to-end rather than individual features

  • Solid instincts for animation principles including easing curves, choreography, anticipation, follow-through, interruptibility, and perceived performance

  • Fluency in Figma at expert level — auto-layout, variants, variables, and code connect — and proficiency with design engineering technologies like framer-motion, gsap, and lottie for web-based animation

  • A demonstrable obsession with craft, backed by a portfolio, side projects, GitHub, or production work that includes systems-level work and not just feature work

  • Experience driving adoption of a design system or shared platform across an engineering org, with a track record of influencing technical or design direction beyond your immediate team

  • Experience with AI product surfaces — tool-call UIs, streaming responses, agent state, and dynamic UI rendering — and comfort navigating ambiguous, cross-team problems with good judgment about when to loop others in

  • A genuine commitment to WRITER's values of Connect, Challenge, and Own

🍩 Benefits & perks (UK full-time employees):

  • Generous PTO, plus company holidays

  • Comprehensive medical and dental insurance

  • Paid parental leave for all parents (16 weeks)

  • Fertility and family planning support

  • Early-detection cancer testing through Galleri

    • Wellness stipend for gym, massage/chiropractor, personal training, etc.

jobs.title: Channel Partnerships Manager
jobs.description:
Channel Partnerships Manager

About Lyra Health

Lyra Health is a leading provider of evidence-based mental health care, serving more than 20 million people globally in partnership with employers and more than 100 million through health plan and partner relationships. The company has delivered more than 15 million sessions of mental health care, published more than 35 peer-reviewed studies, and delivered unmatched outcomes in terms of access, clinical effectiveness, and cost efficiency. Extensive peer-reviewed research confirms Lyra’s transformative care model helps people recover twice as fast and results in a 26% annual reduction in overall healthcare claims costs. Lyra is transforming access to life-changing mental health care through Lyra Empower, the only fully integrated, AI-powered platform combining the highest-quality care and technology solutions.

About the Role:

As a Channel Manager at Lyra Health, you will operate as the general manager and strategic commercial driver for a portfolio of key health plan and other co-selling partner relationships (including but not limited to large payer organizations). In this role, you are not just maintaining existing relationships—you are directly responsible for end-to-end partner growth, strategic alignment, deal strategy, and joint commercial execution.

You will combine sharp sales acumen with rigorous cross-functional project leadership to co-sell, architect winning deal strategies, and expand Lyra’s footprint across partner ecosystems. You are expected to proactively identify growth opportunities, lead joint go-to-market (GTM) initiatives, and directly drive new Annual Contract Value (ACV) bookings by embedding Lyra deeply into your partners' core commercial strategy.

Responsibilities

1. Deal Strategy & Co-Selling Leadership

  • Actively manage multiple sales motions (co-selling, reselling, etc.) alongside partner sales reps and internal Lyra Employer Solutions Sales on opportunities, architecting tailored deal strategies and value propositions to maximize deal size and ACV.

  • Serve as a strategic deal consultant to guide sales teams on navigating complex health plan partner sales motions, overcoming competitive threats, and positioning Lyra effectively.

  • Identify and unblock deal friction throughout the buyer journey to accelerate deal velocity and boost close rates across indirect channels.

2. End-to-End Partnership Ownership & Strategy

  • Serve as the ultimate business owner for your assigned partner portfolio, orchestrating long-term partnership strategy, quarterly executive business reviews (QBRs), and joint annual revenue plans.

  • Proactively manage the overall health, performance, and strategic alignment of each partner account—from initial onboarding and co-marketing to ongoing integration, retention, and commercial expansion.

  • Establish multi-year partner growth roadmaps that align partner incentives with Lyra’s overarching commercial goals.

3. Cross-Functional Project Leadership

  • Mobilize and lead cross-functional project teams across Product, Marketing, Sales Engineering, Legal, and Customer Success to execute complex strategic initiatives on schedule.

  • Lead high-impact projects (e.g., custom product integrations, GTM product launches, new partner packaging/pricing tier launches) from initial scoping to execution.

  • Drive accountability across both internal departments and external partner stakeholders to ensure seamless operational execution.

4. Proactive Growth, Initiative & Channel Analytics

  • Identify untapped market segments, prospective account lists, and novel positioning strategies within your partner accounts to unlock new revenue streams.

  • Establish, analyze, and report on core channel metrics (pipeline generation, win rates, ACV influence, partner-sourced opportunities, deal velocity).

  • Use performance data and CRM tools to continuously refine partner strategy, optimize sales enablement, and address operational bottlenecks.

About Toptal

Toptal is a global network of top talent in business, design, and technology that enables companies to scale their teams, on-demand. With $200+ million in annual revenue and team members based around the globe, Toptal is the world’s largest fully remote workforce.
